target datalayout = "e-m:w-p270:32:32-p271:32:32-p272:64:64-i64:64-i128:128-f80:128-n8:16:32:64-S128"
target triple = "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"
declare ptr @GetStdHandle(i32)
declare i32 @GetConsoleMode(ptr, ptr)
declare i32 @WriteConsoleW(ptr, ptr, i32, ptr, ptr)
declare i32 @WriteFile(ptr, ptr, i32, ptr, ptr)
declare i32 @MultiByteToWideChar(i32, i32, ptr, i32, ptr, i32)
declare ptr @GetProcessHeap()
declare ptr @HeapAlloc(ptr, i32, i64)
declare i32 @HeapFree(ptr, i32, ptr)
define internal i32 @sollang_write_stream_chunk(ptr %handle, ptr %data, i32 %len, ptr %written, i1 %is_console) {
entry:
  %empty = icmp eq i32 %len, 0
  br i1 %empty, label %success_empty, label %classify

success_empty:
  store i32 0, ptr %written, align 4
  ret i32 1

classify:
  br i1 %is_console, label %console_prepare, label %redirected

redirected:
  br label %redirected_write

redirected_write:
  %redirected_offset = phi i32 [ 0, %redirected ], [ %redirected_next, %redirected_advance ]
  %redirected_remaining = sub i32 %len, %redirected_offset
  %redirected_offset64 = zext i32 %redirected_offset to i64
  %redirected_data = getelementptr i8, ptr %data, i64 %redirected_offset64
  store i32 0, ptr %written, align 4
  %redirected_ok = call i32 @WriteFile(ptr %handle, ptr %redirected_data, i32 %redirected_remaining, ptr %written, ptr null)
  %redirected_count = load i32, ptr %written, align 4
  %redirected_succeeded = icmp ne i32 %redirected_ok, 0
  %redirected_progress = icmp ugt i32 %redirected_count, 0
  %redirected_bounded = icmp ule i32 %redirected_count, %redirected_remaining
  %redirected_valid0 = and i1 %redirected_succeeded, %redirected_progress
  %redirected_valid = and i1 %redirected_valid0, %redirected_bounded
  br i1 %redirected_valid, label %redirected_advance, label %write_failed

redirected_advance:
  %redirected_next = add i32 %redirected_offset, %redirected_count
  %redirected_complete = icmp eq i32 %redirected_next, %len
  br i1 %redirected_complete, label %write_succeeded, label %redirected_write

console_prepare:
  %wide_chars = call i32 @MultiByteToWideChar(i32 65001, i32 8, ptr %data, i32 %len, ptr null, i32 0)
  %valid_utf8 = icmp sgt i32 %wide_chars, 0
  br i1 %valid_utf8, label %allocate, label %conversion_failed

allocate:
  %wide_bytes32 = shl i32 %wide_chars, 1
  %wide_bytes = zext i32 %wide_bytes32 to i64
  %heap = call ptr @GetProcessHeap()
  %wide = call ptr @HeapAlloc(ptr %heap, i32 0, i64 %wide_bytes)
  %wide_written = alloca i32, align 4
  %allocated = icmp ne ptr %wide, null
  br i1 %allocated, label %convert, label %conversion_failed

convert:
  %converted = call i32 @MultiByteToWideChar(i32 65001, i32 8, ptr %data, i32 %len, ptr %wide, i32 %wide_chars)
  %converted_all = icmp eq i32 %converted, %wide_chars
  br i1 %converted_all, label %console_write, label %conversion_free

console_write:
  %console_offset = phi i32 [ 0, %convert ], [ %console_next, %console_advance ]
  %console_remaining = sub i32 %wide_chars, %console_offset
  %console_offset64 = zext i32 %console_offset to i64
  %console_data = getelementptr i16, ptr %wide, i64 %console_offset64
  store i32 0, ptr %wide_written, align 4
  %console_ok = call i32 @WriteConsoleW(ptr %handle, ptr %console_data, i32 %console_remaining, ptr %wide_written, ptr null)
  %console_count = load i32, ptr %wide_written, align 4
  %console_succeeded = icmp ne i32 %console_ok, 0
  %console_progress = icmp ugt i32 %console_count, 0
  %console_bounded = icmp ule i32 %console_count, %console_remaining
  %console_valid0 = and i1 %console_succeeded, %console_progress
  %console_valid = and i1 %console_valid0, %console_bounded
  br i1 %console_valid, label %console_advance, label %console_write_failed

console_advance:
  %console_next = add i32 %console_offset, %console_count
  %console_complete = icmp eq i32 %console_next, %wide_chars
  br i1 %console_complete, label %console_write_succeeded, label %console_write

console_write_succeeded:
  %freed = call i32 @HeapFree(ptr %heap, i32 0, ptr %wide)
  br label %write_succeeded

console_write_failed:
  %freed_after_write_failure = call i32 @HeapFree(ptr %heap, i32 0, ptr %wide)
  br label %write_failed

write_succeeded:
  store i32 %len, ptr %written, align 4
  ret i32 1

write_failed:
  store i32 0, ptr %written, align 4
  ret i32 0

conversion_free:
  %freed_after_failure = call i32 @HeapFree(ptr %heap, i32 0, ptr %wide)
  br label %conversion_failed

conversion_failed:
  store i32 0, ptr %written, align 4
  ret i32 0
}

define internal i32 @sollang_write_stream(ptr %handle, ptr %data, i64 %len64, ptr %written, i1 %is_console) {
entry:
  %empty = icmp eq i64 %len64, 0
  br i1 %empty, label %success_empty, label %prepare

success_empty:
  store i32 0, ptr %written, align 4
  ret i32 1

prepare:
  %offset = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %advance ]
  %remaining = sub i64 %len64, %offset
  %current = getelementptr i8, ptr %data, i64 %offset
  %more = icmp ugt i64 %remaining, 1048576
  %proposed = select i1 %more, i64 1048576, i64 %remaining
  %split_console = and i1 %more, %is_console
  br i1 %split_console, label %trim_boundary, label %write

trim_boundary:
  %boundary = phi i64 [ 1048576, %prepare ], [ %previous, %trim_next ]
  %boundary_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %current, i64 %boundary
  %boundary_byte = load i8, ptr %boundary_ptr, align 1
  %prefix = and i8 %boundary_byte, -64
  %continuation = icmp eq i8 %prefix, -128
  br i1 %continuation, label %trim_next, label %write

trim_next:
  %can_trim = icmp ugt i64 %boundary, 1048573
  %previous = sub i64 %boundary, 1
  br i1 %can_trim, label %trim_boundary, label %failure

write:
  %chunk64 = phi i64 [ %proposed, %prepare ], [ %boundary, %trim_boundary ]
  %chunk32 = trunc i64 %chunk64 to i32
  %ok = call i32 @sollang_write_stream_chunk(ptr %handle, ptr %current, i32 %chunk32, ptr %written, i1 %is_console)
  %succeeded = icmp ne i32 %ok, 0
  br i1 %succeeded, label %advance, label %failure

advance:
  %next = add i64 %offset, %chunk64
  %complete = icmp eq i64 %next, %len64
  br i1 %complete, label %success, label %prepare

success:
  ret i32 1

failure:
  store i32 0, ptr %written, align 4
  ret i32 0
}

define internal i32 @sollang_runtime_write_stdout_all(ptr %handle, ptr %data, i64 %len) {
entry:
  %written = alloca i32, align 4
  %mode = alloca i32, align 4
  %empty = icmp eq i64 %len, 0
  br i1 %empty, label %success, label %classify
classify:
  %console_status = call i32 @GetConsoleMode(ptr %handle, ptr %mode)
  %is_console = icmp ne i32 %console_status, 0
  %ok = call i32 @sollang_write_stream(ptr %handle, ptr %data, i64 %len, ptr %written, i1 %is_console)
  ret i32 %ok
success:
  ret i32 1
}
define internal i32 @sollang_runtime_write_stdout_bytes(ptr %handle, ptr %data, i32 %len) {
entry:
  %length = zext i32 %len to i64
  %ok = call i32 @sollang_runtime_write_stdout_all(ptr %handle, ptr %data, i64 %length)
  ret i32 %ok
}
@sollang_runtime_newline = private constant [1 x i8] c"\0A"
@sollang_runtime_stdout_buffer = private global [1048576 x i8] zeroinitializer
@sollang_runtime_stdout_count = private global i64 0
declare void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr, ptr, i64, i1 immarg)
define internal void @sollang_runtime_flush_stdout() {
entry:
  %count = load i64, ptr @sollang_runtime_stdout_count, align 8
  %has_data = icmp ugt i64 %count, 0
  br i1 %has_data, label %write, label %done
write:
  %handle = call ptr @GetStdHandle(i32 -11)
  %count32 = trunc i64 %count to i32
  %ok = call i32 @sollang_runtime_write_stdout_bytes(ptr %handle, ptr @sollang_runtime_stdout_buffer, i32 %count32)
  %succeeded = icmp ne i32 %ok, 0
  br i1 %succeeded, label %clear, label %failure
clear:
  store i64 0, ptr @sollang_runtime_stdout_count, align 8
  br label %done
failure:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
done:
  ret void
}
define internal void @sollang_runtime_append_stdout(ptr %data, i64 %len) {
entry:
  %count = load i64, ptr @sollang_runtime_stdout_count, align 8
  %total = add i64 %count, %len
  %available = sub i64 1048576, %count
  %fits = icmp ule i64 %len, %available
  br i1 %fits, label %append, label %flush
flush:
  call void @sollang_runtime_flush_stdout()
  %large = icmp ugt i64 %len, 1048576
  br i1 %large, label %direct, label %append_empty
direct:
  %handle = call ptr @GetStdHandle(i32 -11)
  %ok = call i32 @sollang_runtime_write_stdout_all(ptr %handle, ptr %data, i64 %len)
  %succeeded = icmp ne i32 %ok, 0
  br i1 %succeeded, label %direct_done, label %direct_failure
direct_done:
  ret void
direct_failure:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
append_empty:
  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr @sollang_runtime_stdout_buffer, ptr %data, i64 %len, i1 false)
  store i64 %len, ptr @sollang_runtime_stdout_count, align 8
  ret void
append:
  %slot = getelementptr i8, ptr @sollang_runtime_stdout_buffer, i64 %count
  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %slot, ptr %data, i64 %len, i1 false)
  store i64 %total, ptr @sollang_runtime_stdout_count, align 8
  ret void
}
define internal void @sollang_runtime_print(ptr %data, i64 %len, i1 %newline) {
entry:
  call void @sollang_runtime_append_stdout(ptr %data, i64 %len)
  br i1 %newline, label %write_newline, label %done
write_newline:
  call void @sollang_runtime_append_stdout(ptr @sollang_runtime_newline, i64 1)
  br label %done
done:
  ret void
}
@sollang_runtime_error_newline = private constant [2 x i8] c"\0D\0A"
define internal void @sollang_runtime_eprint(ptr %data, i64 %len, i1 %newline) {
entry:
  %handle = call ptr @GetStdHandle(i32 -12)
  %ok = call i32 @sollang_runtime_write_stdout_all(ptr %handle, ptr %data, i64 %len)
  br i1 %newline, label %write_newline, label %done
write_newline:
  %newline_ok = call i32 @sollang_runtime_write_stdout_bytes(ptr %handle, ptr @sollang_runtime_error_newline, i32 2)
  br label %done
done:
  ret void
}
define internal void @sollang_runtime_eprintln(ptr %data, i64 %len) {
entry:
  call void @sollang_runtime_eprint(ptr %data, i64 %len, i1 true)
  ret void
}
define internal i64 @sollang_format_u64(ptr %dest, i64 %value) {
entry:
  br label %count
count:
  %count_n = phi i64 [ %value, %entry ], [ %count_q, %count_more ]
  %length = phi i64 [ 1, %entry ], [ %next_length, %count_more ]
  %count_q = udiv i64 %count_n, 10
  %count_done = icmp eq i64 %count_q, 0
  br i1 %count_done, label %write_entry, label %count_more
count_more:
  %next_length = add i64 %length, 1
  br label %count
write_entry:
  %last_index = sub i64 %length, 1
  br label %write
write:
  %write_n = phi i64 [ %value, %write_entry ], [ %write_q, %write ]
  %index = phi i64 [ %last_index, %write_entry ], [ %previous_index, %write ]
  %digit = urem i64 %write_n, 10
  %write_q = udiv i64 %write_n, 10
  %digit8 = trunc i64 %digit to i8
  %ascii = add i8 %digit8, 48
  %slot = getelementptr i8, ptr %dest, i64 %index
  store i8 %ascii, ptr %slot, align 1
  %previous_index = sub i64 %index, 1
  %write_done = icmp eq i64 %write_q, 0
  br i1 %write_done, label %return, label %write
return:
  ret i64 %length
}
define internal i64 @sollang_format_i64(ptr %dest, i64 %value) {
entry:
  %negative = icmp slt i64 %value, 0
  br i1 %negative, label %negative_value, label %positive_value
negative_value:
  store i8 45, ptr %dest, align 1
  %digits_dest = getelementptr i8, ptr %dest, i64 1
  %magnitude = sub i64 0, %value
  %negative_digits = call i64 @sollang_format_u64(ptr %digits_dest, i64 %magnitude)
  %negative_length = add i64 %negative_digits, 1
  ret i64 %negative_length
positive_value:
  %positive_length = call i64 @sollang_format_u64(ptr %dest, i64 %value)
  ret i64 %positive_length
}
define internal void @sollang_runtime_print_i32(i32 %value, i1 %newline) {
entry:
  %buffer = alloca [12 x i8], align 1
  %end = getelementptr [12 x i8], ptr %buffer, i64 0, i64 12
  %wide = sext i32 %value to i64
  %negative = icmp slt i64 %wide, 0
  %negated = sub i64 0, %wide
  %magnitude = select i1 %negative, i64 %negated, i64 %wide
  br label %digits
digits:
  %current = phi i64 [ %magnitude, %entry ], [ %quotient, %digits ]
  %cursor = phi ptr [ %end, %entry ], [ %digit_slot, %digits ]
  %digit = urem i64 %current, 10
  %quotient = udiv i64 %current, 10
  %digit_slot = getelementptr i8, ptr %cursor, i64 -1
  %digit8 = trunc i64 %digit to i8
  %ascii = add i8 %digit8, 48
  store i8 %ascii, ptr %digit_slot, align 1
  %more = icmp ne i64 %quotient, 0
  br i1 %more, label %digits, label %digits_done
digits_done:
  br i1 %negative, label %write_sign, label %emit
write_sign:
  %sign_slot = getelementptr i8, ptr %digit_slot, i64 -1
  store i8 45, ptr %sign_slot, align 1
  br label %emit
emit:
  %start = phi ptr [ %digit_slot, %digits_done ], [ %sign_slot, %write_sign ]
  %end_address = ptrtoint ptr %end to i64
  %start_address = ptrtoint ptr %start to i64
  %length = sub i64 %end_address, %start_address
  call void @sollang_runtime_print(ptr %start, i64 %length, i1 %newline)
  ret void
}
define internal void @sollang_runtime_print_i64(i64 %value, i1 %signed, i1 %newline) {
entry:
  %buffer = alloca [21 x i8], align 1
  %end = getelementptr [21 x i8], ptr %buffer, i64 0, i64 21
  %negative_value = icmp slt i64 %value, 0
  %negative = and i1 %signed, %negative_value
  %negated = sub i64 0, %value
  %magnitude = select i1 %negative, i64 %negated, i64 %value
  br label %digits
digits:
  %current = phi i64 [ %magnitude, %entry ], [ %quotient, %digits ]
  %cursor = phi ptr [ %end, %entry ], [ %digit_slot, %digits ]
  %digit = urem i64 %current, 10
  %quotient = udiv i64 %current, 10
  %digit_slot = getelementptr i8, ptr %cursor, i64 -1
  %digit8 = trunc i64 %digit to i8

  store i8 %ascii, ptr %digit_slot, align 1
  %more = icmp ne i64 %quotient, 0
  br i1 %more, label %digits, label %digits_done
digits_done:

  %length = sub i64 %end_address, %start_address
  call void @sollang_runtime_print(ptr %start, i64 %length, i1 %newline)
  ret void
}
@sollang_runtime_bool_true = private constant [4 x i8] c"true"

%sollang.text = type { ptr, i64 }
%sollang.stream = type { ptr, ptr, ptr }
%sollang.event_stream = type { ptr, ptr, ptr }
define internal i1 @sollang_range_stream_next(ptr %context, ptr %output) {
entry:
  %done_address = getelementptr i8, ptr %context, i64 8
  %done = load i1, ptr %done_address, align 1
  br i1 %done, label %finished, label %active
active:
  %current = load i32, ptr %context, align 4
  %end_address = getelementptr i8, ptr %context, i64 4
  %end = load i32, ptr %end_address, align 4
  %past_end = icmp sgt i32 %current, %end
  br i1 %past_end, label %mark_finished, label %yield
yield:
  store i32 %current, ptr %output, align 4
  %is_last = icmp eq i32 %current, %end
  br i1 %is_last, label %mark_finished_after_yield, label %advance
advance:
  %next = add i32 %current, 1
  store i32 %next, ptr %context, align 4
  ret i1 true
mark_finished_after_yield:
  store i1 true, ptr %done_address, align 1
  ret i1 true
mark_finished:
  store i1 true, ptr %done_address, align 1
  ret i1 false
finished:
  ret i1 false
}
define internal void @sollang_stream_heap_drop(ptr %context, i1 %destroy) {
entry:
  br i1 %destroy, label %release, label %done
release:
  call void @free(ptr %context)
  br label %done
done:
  ret void
}
define internal %sollang.stream @sollang_range_stream_create({ i32, i32 } %range) {
entry:
  %context = call ptr @malloc(i64 12)
  %start = extractvalue { i32, i32 } %range, 0
  %end = extractvalue { i32, i32 } %range, 1
  store i32 %start, ptr %context, align 4
  %end_address = getelementptr i8, ptr %context, i64 4
  store i32 %end, ptr %end_address, align 4
  %done_address = getelementptr i8, ptr %context, i64 8
  store i1 false, ptr %done_address, align 1
  %with_context = insertvalue %sollang.stream poison, ptr %context, 0
  %with_next = insertvalue %sollang.stream %with_context, ptr @sollang_range_stream_next, 1
  %result = insertvalue %sollang.stream %with_next, ptr @sollang_stream_heap_drop, 2
  ret %sollang.stream %result
}

  %set118121_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118121_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118121_find_grouped_first_deleted

set118121_missing:

  %set118121_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118121_next_length, 8

  store %sollang.dict %set118121_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8

set118121_grow:

  br label %set118121_grow_rehash_find_done

set118121_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118121_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118121_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118121_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe

  %set118121_grow_rehash_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118121_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118121_grown_capacity

  store i32 %set118121_grow_rehash_key, ptr %set118121_grow_rehash_new_key_ptr, align 4

  store i8 %set118121_grow_rehash_h2, ptr %set118121_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_ptr, align 1

set118121_grow_rehash_done:

  %set118124_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118124_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118124_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118124_find_grouped_candidates
set118124_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118124_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118124_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118124_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118124_find_grouped_empty, label %set118124_find_grouped_next_group
set118124_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118124_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118124_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118124_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118124_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118124_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118124_find_grouped_group_start, %set118124_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118124_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118124_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118124_find_grouped_mask
  %set118124_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118124_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118124_capacity
  %set118124_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118124_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118124_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118124_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118124_find_grouped_done
set118124_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118124_find_grouped_done
set118124_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118124_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118124_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118124_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118124_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118124_find_grouped_group
set118124_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118124_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118124_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118124_capacity
  %set118124_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118124_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118124_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118124_find_grouped_done
set118124_find_grouped_done:
  %set118124_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118124_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118124_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118124_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118124_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118124_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118124_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118124_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118124_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118124_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118124_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118124_find_done
set118124_find_done:
  %set118124_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118124_find_match ], [ false, %set118124_find_vacant ], [ %set118124_find_grouped_found, %set118124_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118124_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118124_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118124_find_start, %set118124_find_match ], [ %set118124_find_start, %set118124_find_vacant ], [ %set118124_find_grouped_slot, %set118124_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118124_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118124_slot = add i64 %set118124_find_slot, 0
  br i1 %set118124_find_found, label %set118124_found, label %set118124_missing
set118124_missing:
  %set118124_insert_slot = add i64 %set118124_find_slot, 0
  %set118124_next_length = add i64 %set118124_length, 1
  %set118124_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118124_next_length, 8
  %set118124_load_limit = mul i64 %set118124_capacity, 7
  %set118124_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118124_scaled_length, %set118124_load_limit
  br i1 %set118124_fits, label %set118124_insert_current, label %set118124_grow
set118124_insert_current:
  %set118124_insert_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118124_keys, i64 %set118124_insert_slot
  store i32 %set118124_query, ptr %set118124_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118124_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118124_controls, i64 %set118124_insert_slot
  %set118124_insert_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118124_controls, i64 %set118124_insert_slot
  store i8 %set118124_h2, ptr %set118124_insert_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118124_insert_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118124_insert_slot, 16
  %set118124_insert_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118124_insert_slot, %set118124_capacity
  %set118124_insert_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118124_insert_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118124_insert_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118124_insert_slot
  %set118124_insert_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118124_controls, i64 %set118124_insert_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118124_h2, ptr %set118124_insert_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  %set118124_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118124_source, i64 %set118124_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118124_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118124_inserted
set118124_grow:
  %set118124_grown_capacity = mul i64 %set118124_capacity, 2
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_entry
set118124_grow_rehash_entry:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror = add i64 %set118124_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8
  %set118124_grow_rehash_entry_bytes = mul i64 %set118124_grown_capacity, 4
  %set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes = add i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_offset, %set118124_grow_rehash_entry_bytes
  %set118124_grow_rehash_storage = call ptr @malloc(i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes)
  %set118124_grow_rehash_allocated = icmp ne ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_storage, null
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_allocated, label %set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_ready, label %set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_failed
set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_failed:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_ready:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_storage, i64 0
  %set118124_grow_rehash_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118124_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118124_grow_rehash_entries_offset = and i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118124_grow_rehash_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_storage, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_entries_offset
  %set118124_grow_rehash_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_keys, i64 4
  %set118124_grow_rehash_control_bytes = add i64 %set118124_grown_capacity, 16
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_controls, i8 0, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_control_bytes, i1 false)
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_loop
set118124_grow_rehash_loop:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_index = phi i64 [ 0, %set118124_grow_rehash_allocation_ready ], [ %set118124_grow_rehash_next_index, %set118124_grow_rehash_advance ]
  %set118124_grow_rehash_active = icmp ult i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_index, %set118124_capacity
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_active, label %set118124_grow_rehash_check, label %set118124_grow_rehash_done
set118124_grow_rehash_check:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118124_controls, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_index
  %set118124_grow_rehash_old_control = load i8, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118124_grow_rehash_occupied = icmp sgt i8 %set118124_grow_rehash_old_control, 0
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_occupied, label %set118124_grow_rehash_move, label %set118124_grow_rehash_advance
set118124_grow_rehash_move:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118124_keys, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_index
  %set118124_grow_rehash_key = load i32, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118124_grow_rehash_key64 = sext i32 %set118124_grow_rehash_key to i64
  %set118124_grow_rehash_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_key64, 32
  %set118124_grow_rehash_hash_fold = xor i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_key64, %set118124_grow_rehash_hash_high
  %set118124_grow_rehash_hash = mul i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131
  %set118124_grow_rehash_h2_shifted = lshr i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_hash, 57
  %set118124_grow_rehash_h2_raw = and i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118124_grow_rehash_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_h2_raw, 0
  %set118124_grow_rehash_h2_value = select i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_h2_raw
  %set118124_grow_rehash_h2 = trunc i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_h2_value to i8
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_mask = sub i64 %set118124_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_start = and i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_hash, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_mask
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118124_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_first, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity
set118124_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_done
set118124_grow_rehash_find_first:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_empty = icmp eq i8 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_control, 0
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_empty, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_vacant, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_occupied
set118124_grow_rehash_find_occupied:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_control, %set118124_grow_rehash_h2
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_h2_match, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_compare, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118124_grow_rehash_find_compare:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_key, %set118124_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_equal, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_match, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118124_grow_rehash_find_match:
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_done
set118124_grow_rehash_find_vacant:
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_done
set118124_grow_rehash_find_fallback:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask = sub i64 %set118124_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_hash, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118124_grown_capacity, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, %set118124_grown_capacity
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118124_grow_rehash_h2, i64 0
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118124_grown_capacity
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key = load i32, ptr %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key, %set118124_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_equal, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty, label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118124_grown_capacity
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118124_grown_capacity
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done:
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118124_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118124_grow_rehash_find_done

  %set118127_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118127_find_grouped_group_start, %set118127_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118127_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118127_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118127_find_grouped_mask
  %set118127_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118127_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118127_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118127_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118127_find_grouped_candidates
set118127_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118127_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118127_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118127_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118127_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118127_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118127_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118127_find_grouped_decision

  %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118127_find_grouped_group_start, %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118127_find_grouped_mask
  %set118127_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118127_keys, i64 %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_slot
  %set118127_find_grouped_key = load i32, ptr %set118127_find_grouped_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118127_find_grouped_key, %set118127_query
  br i1 %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_equal, label %set118127_find_grouped_match, label %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_next
set118127_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118127_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118127_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118127_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118127_find_grouped_candidates
set118127_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118127_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118127_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118127_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118127_find_grouped_empty, label %set118127_find_grouped_next_group
set118127_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118127_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118127_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118127_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118127_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118127_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118127_find_grouped_group_start, %set118127_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118127_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118127_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118127_find_grouped_mask
  %set118127_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118127_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118127_capacity
  %set118127_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118127_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118127_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118127_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118127_find_grouped_done
set118127_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118127_find_grouped_done
set118127_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118127_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118127_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118127_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118127_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118127_find_grouped_group
set118127_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118127_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118127_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118127_capacity
  %set118127_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118127_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118127_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118127_find_grouped_done
set118127_find_grouped_done:
  %set118127_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118127_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118127_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118127_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118127_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118127_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118127_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118127_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118127_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118127_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118127_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118127_find_done
set118127_find_done:
  %set118127_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118127_find_match ], [ false, %set118127_find_vacant ], [ %set118127_find_grouped_found, %set118127_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118127_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118127_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118127_find_start, %set118127_find_match ], [ %set118127_find_start, %set118127_find_vacant ], [ %set118127_find_grouped_slot, %set118127_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118127_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118127_slot = add i64 %set118127_find_slot, 0
  br i1 %set118127_find_found, label %set118127_found, label %set118127_missing
set118127_missing:
  %set118127_insert_slot = add i64 %set118127_find_slot, 0
  %set118127_next_length = add i64 %set118127_length, 1
  %set118127_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118127_next_length, 8
  %set118127_load_limit = mul i64 %set118127_capacity, 7
  %set118127_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118127_scaled_length, %set118127_load_limit
  br i1 %set118127_fits, label %set118127_insert_current, label %set118127_grow
set118127_insert_current:
  %set118127_insert_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118127_keys, i64 %set118127_insert_slot
  store i32 %set118127_query, ptr %set118127_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118127_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118127_controls, i64 %set118127_insert_slot
  %set118127_insert_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118127_controls, i64 %set118127_insert_slot
  store i8 %set118127_h2, ptr %set118127_insert_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118127_insert_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118127_insert_slot, 16
  %set118127_insert_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118127_insert_slot, %set118127_capacity
  %set118127_insert_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118127_insert_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118127_insert_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118127_insert_slot
  %set118127_insert_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118127_controls, i64 %set118127_insert_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118127_h2, ptr %set118127_insert_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  %set118127_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118127_source, i64 %set118127_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118127_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118127_inserted
set118127_grow:
  %set118127_grown_capacity = mul i64 %set118127_capacity, 2
  br label %set118127_grow_rehash_entry
set118127_grow_rehash_entry:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror = add i64 %set118127_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8
  %set118127_grow_rehash_entry_bytes = mul i64 %set118127_grown_capacity, 4
  %set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes = add i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_offset, %set118127_grow_rehash_entry_bytes
  %set118127_grow_rehash_storage = call ptr @malloc(i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes)
  %set118127_grow_rehash_allocated = icmp ne ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_storage, null
  br i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_allocated, label %set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_ready, label %set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_failed
set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_failed:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_ready:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_storage, i64 0
  %set118127_grow_rehash_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118127_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118127_grow_rehash_entries_offset = and i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118127_grow_rehash_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_storage, i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_entries_offset
  %set118127_grow_rehash_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_keys, i64 4
  %set118127_grow_rehash_control_bytes = add i64 %set118127_grown_capacity, 16
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_controls, i8 0, i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_control_bytes, i1 false)
  br label %set118127_grow_rehash_loop
set118127_grow_rehash_loop:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_index = phi i64 [ 0, %set118127_grow_rehash_allocation_ready ], [ %set118127_grow_rehash_next_index, %set118127_grow_rehash_advance ]
  %set118127_grow_rehash_active = icmp ult i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_index, %set118127_capacity
  br i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_active, label %set118127_grow_rehash_check, label %set118127_grow_rehash_done
set118127_grow_rehash_check:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118127_controls, i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_index
  %set118127_grow_rehash_old_control = load i8, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118127_grow_rehash_occupied = icmp sgt i8 %set118127_grow_rehash_old_control, 0
  br i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_occupied, label %set118127_grow_rehash_move, label %set118127_grow_rehash_advance
set118127_grow_rehash_move:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118127_keys, i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_index
  %set118127_grow_rehash_key = load i32, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118127_grow_rehash_key64 = sext i32 %set118127_grow_rehash_key to i64
  %set118127_grow_rehash_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_key64, 32
  %set118127_grow_rehash_hash_fold = xor i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_key64, %set118127_grow_rehash_hash_high
  %set118127_grow_rehash_hash = mul i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131
  %set118127_grow_rehash_h2_shifted = lshr i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_hash, 57
  %set118127_grow_rehash_h2_raw = and i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118127_grow_rehash_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_h2_raw, 0
  %set118127_grow_rehash_h2_value = select i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_h2_raw
  %set118127_grow_rehash_h2 = trunc i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_h2_value to i8
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_mask = sub i64 %set118127_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_start = and i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_hash, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_mask
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118127_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_first, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity
set118127_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_done
set118127_grow_rehash_find_first:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr, align 1

  br i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_h2_match, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_compare, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_fallback

  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr, align 4

  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_hash, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry
set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118127_grown_capacity, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, %set118127_grown_capacity
  br i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss
set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118127_grow_rehash_h2, i64 0
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer

  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0

  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)

  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask

  br label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision

  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118127_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot

  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty, label %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group
set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118127_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask

  %set118130_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_controls, i64 %set118130_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118130_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118130_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118130_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118130_h2, i64 0
  %set118130_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118130_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118130_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118130_find_grouped_controls, %set118130_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118130_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118130_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118130_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118130_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118130_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118130_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118130_find_grouped_controls, %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118130_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118130_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118130_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118130_capacity
  %set118130_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118130_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118130_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64
  %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118130_find_grouped_group_start, %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118130_find_grouped_mask
  %set118130_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118130_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118130_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118130_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118130_find_grouped_candidates
set118130_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118130_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118130_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118130_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118130_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118130_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118130_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118130_find_grouped_decision
set118130_find_grouped_candidate:
  %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118130_find_grouped_group_start, %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118130_find_grouped_mask
  %set118130_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118130_keys, i64 %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_slot
  %set118130_find_grouped_key = load i32, ptr %set118130_find_grouped_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118130_find_grouped_key, %set118130_query
  br i1 %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_equal, label %set118130_find_grouped_match, label %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_next
set118130_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118130_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118130_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118130_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118130_find_grouped_candidates
set118130_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118130_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118130_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118130_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118130_find_grouped_empty, label %set118130_find_grouped_next_group
set118130_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118130_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118130_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118130_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118130_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118130_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118130_find_grouped_group_start, %set118130_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118130_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118130_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118130_find_grouped_mask
  %set118130_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118130_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118130_capacity
  %set118130_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118130_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118130_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118130_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118130_find_grouped_done
set118130_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118130_find_grouped_done
set118130_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118130_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118130_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118130_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118130_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118130_find_grouped_group
set118130_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118130_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118130_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118130_capacity
  %set118130_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118130_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118130_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118130_find_grouped_done
set118130_find_grouped_done:
  %set118130_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118130_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118130_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118130_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118130_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118130_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118130_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118130_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118130_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118130_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118130_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118130_find_done
set118130_find_done:
  %set118130_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118130_find_match ], [ false, %set118130_find_vacant ], [ %set118130_find_grouped_found, %set118130_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118130_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118130_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118130_find_start, %set118130_find_match ], [ %set118130_find_start, %set118130_find_vacant ], [ %set118130_find_grouped_slot, %set118130_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118130_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118130_slot = add i64 %set118130_find_slot, 0
  br i1 %set118130_find_found, label %set118130_found, label %set118130_missing
set118130_missing:
  %set118130_insert_slot = add i64 %set118130_find_slot, 0
  %set118130_next_length = add i64 %set118130_length, 1
  %set118130_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118130_next_length, 8
  %set118130_load_limit = mul i64 %set118130_capacity, 7
  %set118130_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118130_scaled_length, %set118130_load_limit
  br i1 %set118130_fits, label %set118130_insert_current, label %set118130_grow
set118130_insert_current:
  %set118130_insert_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118130_keys, i64 %set118130_insert_slot
  store i32 %set118130_query, ptr %set118130_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118130_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_controls, i64 %set118130_insert_slot
  %set118130_insert_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_controls, i64 %set118130_insert_slot
  store i8 %set118130_h2, ptr %set118130_insert_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118130_insert_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118130_insert_slot, 16
  %set118130_insert_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118130_insert_slot, %set118130_capacity
  %set118130_insert_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118130_insert_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118130_insert_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118130_insert_slot
  %set118130_insert_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_controls, i64 %set118130_insert_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118130_h2, ptr %set118130_insert_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  %set118130_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118130_source, i64 %set118130_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118130_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118130_inserted
set118130_grow:
  %set118130_grown_capacity = mul i64 %set118130_capacity, 2
  br label %set118130_grow_rehash_entry
set118130_grow_rehash_entry:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror = add i64 %set118130_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8
  %set118130_grow_rehash_entry_bytes = mul i64 %set118130_grown_capacity, 4
  %set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes = add i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_offset, %set118130_grow_rehash_entry_bytes
  %set118130_grow_rehash_storage = call ptr @malloc(i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes)
  %set118130_grow_rehash_allocated = icmp ne ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_storage, null
  br i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_allocated, label %set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_ready, label %set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_failed
set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_failed:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_ready:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_storage, i64 0
  %set118130_grow_rehash_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118130_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118130_grow_rehash_entries_offset = and i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118130_grow_rehash_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_storage, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_entries_offset
  %set118130_grow_rehash_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_keys, i64 4
  %set118130_grow_rehash_control_bytes = add i64 %set118130_grown_capacity, 16
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_controls, i8 0, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_control_bytes, i1 false)
  br label %set118130_grow_rehash_loop
set118130_grow_rehash_loop:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_index = phi i64 [ 0, %set118130_grow_rehash_allocation_ready ], [ %set118130_grow_rehash_next_index, %set118130_grow_rehash_advance ]
  %set118130_grow_rehash_active = icmp ult i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_index, %set118130_capacity
  br i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_active, label %set118130_grow_rehash_check, label %set118130_grow_rehash_done
set118130_grow_rehash_check:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_controls, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_index
  %set118130_grow_rehash_old_control = load i8, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118130_grow_rehash_occupied = icmp sgt i8 %set118130_grow_rehash_old_control, 0
  br i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_occupied, label %set118130_grow_rehash_move, label %set118130_grow_rehash_advance
set118130_grow_rehash_move:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118130_keys, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_index
  %set118130_grow_rehash_key = load i32, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118130_grow_rehash_key64 = sext i32 %set118130_grow_rehash_key to i64
  %set118130_grow_rehash_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_key64, 32
  %set118130_grow_rehash_hash_fold = xor i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_key64, %set118130_grow_rehash_hash_high
  %set118130_grow_rehash_hash = mul i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131
  %set118130_grow_rehash_h2_shifted = lshr i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_hash, 57
  %set118130_grow_rehash_h2_raw = and i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118130_grow_rehash_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_h2_raw, 0
  %set118130_grow_rehash_h2_value = select i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_h2_raw
  %set118130_grow_rehash_h2 = trunc i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_h2_value to i8
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_mask = sub i64 %set118130_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_start = and i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_hash, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_mask
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118130_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_first, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity
set118130_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_done
set118130_grow_rehash_find_first:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_empty = icmp eq i8 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_control, 0
  br i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_empty, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_vacant, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_occupied
set118130_grow_rehash_find_occupied:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_control, %set118130_grow_rehash_h2
  br i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_h2_match, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_compare, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118130_grow_rehash_find_compare:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_key, %set118130_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_equal, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_match, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118130_grow_rehash_find_match:
  br label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_done
set118130_grow_rehash_find_vacant:
  br label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_done
set118130_grow_rehash_find_fallback:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask = sub i64 %set118130_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_hash, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry
set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118130_grown_capacity, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, %set118130_grown_capacity
  br i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss
set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118130_grow_rehash_h2, i64 0
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118130_grown_capacity
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision
set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate:
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118130_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
