  br i1 %set118133_find_empty, label %set118133_find_vacant, label %set118133_find_occupied
set118133_find_occupied:
  %set118133_find_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118133_find_control, %set118133_h2
  br i1 %set118133_find_h2_match, label %set118133_find_compare, label %set118133_find_fallback
set118133_find_compare:
  %set118133_find_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118133_keys, i64 %set118133_find_start
  %set118133_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118133_find_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118133_find_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118133_find_key, %set118133_query
  br i1 %set118133_find_equal, label %set118133_find_match, label %set118133_find_fallback
set118133_find_match:
  br label %set118133_find_done
set118133_find_vacant:
  br label %set118133_find_done
set118133_find_fallback:
  %set118133_find_grouped_mask = sub i64 %set118133_capacity, 1
  %set118133_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118133_query_hash, %set118133_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118133_find_grouped_entry
set118133_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118133_find_grouped_group
set118133_find_grouped_group:
  %set118133_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118133_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118133_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118133_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118133_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118133_capacity, %set118133_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118133_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118133_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118133_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118133_find_grouped_probe, %set118133_capacity
  br i1 %set118133_find_grouped_active, label %set118133_find_grouped_body, label %set118133_find_grouped_miss
set118133_find_grouped_body:
  %set118133_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118133_find_grouped_start, %set118133_find_grouped_probe
  %set118133_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118133_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118133_find_grouped_mask
  %set118133_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_controls, i64 %set118133_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118133_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118133_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118133_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118133_h2, i64 0
  %set118133_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118133_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118133_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118133_find_grouped_controls, %set118133_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118133_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118133_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118133_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118133_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118133_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118133_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118133_find_grouped_controls, %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118133_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118133_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118133_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118133_capacity
  %set118133_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118133_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118133_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64
  %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118133_find_grouped_group_start, %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118133_find_grouped_mask
  %set118133_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118133_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118133_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118133_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118133_find_grouped_candidates
set118133_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118133_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118133_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118133_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118133_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118133_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118133_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118133_find_grouped_decision
set118133_find_grouped_candidate:
  %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118133_find_grouped_group_start, %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118133_find_grouped_mask
  %set118133_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118133_keys, i64 %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_slot
  %set118133_find_grouped_key = load i32, ptr %set118133_find_grouped_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118133_find_grouped_key, %set118133_query
  br i1 %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_equal, label %set118133_find_grouped_match, label %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_next
set118133_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118133_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118133_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118133_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118133_find_grouped_candidates
set118133_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118133_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118133_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118133_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118133_find_grouped_empty, label %set118133_find_grouped_next_group
set118133_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118133_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118133_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118133_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118133_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118133_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118133_find_grouped_group_start, %set118133_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118133_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118133_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118133_find_grouped_mask
  %set118133_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118133_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118133_capacity
  %set118133_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118133_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118133_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118133_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118133_find_grouped_done
set118133_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118133_find_grouped_done
set118133_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118133_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118133_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118133_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118133_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118133_find_grouped_group
set118133_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118133_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118133_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118133_capacity
  %set118133_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118133_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118133_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118133_find_grouped_done
set118133_find_grouped_done:
  %set118133_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118133_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118133_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118133_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118133_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118133_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118133_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118133_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118133_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118133_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118133_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118133_find_done
set118133_find_done:
  %set118133_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118133_find_match ], [ false, %set118133_find_vacant ], [ %set118133_find_grouped_found, %set118133_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118133_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118133_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118133_find_start, %set118133_find_match ], [ %set118133_find_start, %set118133_find_vacant ], [ %set118133_find_grouped_slot, %set118133_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118133_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118133_slot = add i64 %set118133_find_slot, 0
  br i1 %set118133_find_found, label %set118133_found, label %set118133_missing
set118133_missing:
  %set118133_insert_slot = add i64 %set118133_find_slot, 0
  %set118133_next_length = add i64 %set118133_length, 1
  %set118133_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118133_next_length, 8
  %set118133_load_limit = mul i64 %set118133_capacity, 7
  %set118133_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118133_scaled_length, %set118133_load_limit
  br i1 %set118133_fits, label %set118133_insert_current, label %set118133_grow
set118133_insert_current:
  %set118133_insert_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118133_keys, i64 %set118133_insert_slot
  store i32 %set118133_query, ptr %set118133_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118133_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_controls, i64 %set118133_insert_slot
  %set118133_insert_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_controls, i64 %set118133_insert_slot
  store i8 %set118133_h2, ptr %set118133_insert_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118133_insert_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118133_insert_slot, 16
  %set118133_insert_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118133_insert_slot, %set118133_capacity
  %set118133_insert_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118133_insert_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118133_insert_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118133_insert_slot
  %set118133_insert_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_controls, i64 %set118133_insert_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118133_h2, ptr %set118133_insert_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  %set118133_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118133_source, i64 %set118133_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118133_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118133_inserted
set118133_grow:
  %set118133_grown_capacity = mul i64 %set118133_capacity, 2
  br label %set118133_grow_rehash_entry
set118133_grow_rehash_entry:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror = add i64 %set118133_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8
  %set118133_grow_rehash_entry_bytes = mul i64 %set118133_grown_capacity, 4
  %set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes = add i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_offset, %set118133_grow_rehash_entry_bytes
  %set118133_grow_rehash_storage = call ptr @malloc(i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes)
  %set118133_grow_rehash_allocated = icmp ne ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_storage, null
  br i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_allocated, label %set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_ready, label %set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_failed
set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_failed:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_ready:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_storage, i64 0
  %set118133_grow_rehash_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118133_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118133_grow_rehash_entries_offset = and i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118133_grow_rehash_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_storage, i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_entries_offset
  %set118133_grow_rehash_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_keys, i64 4
  %set118133_grow_rehash_control_bytes = add i64 %set118133_grown_capacity, 16
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_controls, i8 0, i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_control_bytes, i1 false)
  br label %set118133_grow_rehash_loop
set118133_grow_rehash_loop:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_index = phi i64 [ 0, %set118133_grow_rehash_allocation_ready ], [ %set118133_grow_rehash_next_index, %set118133_grow_rehash_advance ]
  %set118133_grow_rehash_active = icmp ult i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_index, %set118133_capacity
  br i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_active, label %set118133_grow_rehash_check, label %set118133_grow_rehash_done
set118133_grow_rehash_check:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_controls, i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_index
  %set118133_grow_rehash_old_control = load i8, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118133_grow_rehash_occupied = icmp sgt i8 %set118133_grow_rehash_old_control, 0
  br i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_occupied, label %set118133_grow_rehash_move, label %set118133_grow_rehash_advance
set118133_grow_rehash_move:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118133_keys, i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_index
  %set118133_grow_rehash_key = load i32, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118133_grow_rehash_key64 = sext i32 %set118133_grow_rehash_key to i64
  %set118133_grow_rehash_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_key64, 32
  %set118133_grow_rehash_hash_fold = xor i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_key64, %set118133_grow_rehash_hash_high
  %set118133_grow_rehash_hash = mul i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131
  %set118133_grow_rehash_h2_shifted = lshr i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_hash, 57
  %set118133_grow_rehash_h2_raw = and i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118133_grow_rehash_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_h2_raw, 0
  %set118133_grow_rehash_h2_value = select i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_h2_raw
  %set118133_grow_rehash_h2 = trunc i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_h2_value to i8
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_mask = sub i64 %set118133_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_start = and i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_hash, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_mask
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118133_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_first, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity
set118133_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_done
set118133_grow_rehash_find_first:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_empty = icmp eq i8 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_control, 0
  br i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_empty, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_vacant, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_occupied
set118133_grow_rehash_find_occupied:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_control, %set118133_grow_rehash_h2
  br i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_h2_match, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_compare, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118133_grow_rehash_find_compare:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_key, %set118133_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_equal, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_match, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118133_grow_rehash_find_match:
  br label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_done
set118133_grow_rehash_find_vacant:
  br label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_done
set118133_grow_rehash_find_fallback:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask = sub i64 %set118133_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_hash, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry
set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118133_grown_capacity, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, %set118133_grown_capacity
  br i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body, label %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss
set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118133_grow_rehash_h2, i64 0
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118133_grown_capacity
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118133_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64

  %set118136_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_storage, i64 0
  %set118136_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118136_capacity, 23
  %set118136_entries_offset = and i64 %set118136_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118136_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_storage, i64 %set118136_entries_offset
  %set118136_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_keys, i64 4
  %set118136_query_addr = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 6, ptr %set118136_query_addr, align 4
  %set118136_query = load i32, ptr %set118136_query_addr, align 4
  %set118136_query_key64 = sext i32 %set118136_query to i64
  %set118136_query_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118136_query_key64, 32
  %set118136_query_hash_fold = xor i64 %set118136_query_key64, %set118136_query_hash_high
  %set118136_query_hash = mul i64 %set118136_query_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131
  %set118136_h2_shifted = lshr i64 %set118136_query_hash, 57
  %set118136_h2_raw = and i64 %set118136_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118136_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118136_h2_raw, 0
  %set118136_h2_value = select i1 %set118136_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118136_h2_raw
  %set118136_h2 = trunc i64 %set118136_h2_value to i8
  %set118136_find_mask = sub i64 %set118136_capacity, 1
  %set118136_find_start = and i64 %set118136_query_hash, %set118136_find_mask
  %set118136_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118136_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118136_find_has_capacity, label %set118136_find_first, label %set118136_find_no_capacity
set118136_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118136_find_done
set118136_find_first:
  %set118136_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_controls, i64 %set118136_find_start
  %set118136_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118136_find_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118136_find_empty = icmp eq i8 %set118136_find_control, 0
  br i1 %set118136_find_empty, label %set118136_find_vacant, label %set118136_find_occupied
set118136_find_occupied:
  %set118136_find_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118136_find_control, %set118136_h2
  br i1 %set118136_find_h2_match, label %set118136_find_compare, label %set118136_find_fallback
set118136_find_compare:
  %set118136_find_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118136_keys, i64 %set118136_find_start
  %set118136_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118136_find_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118136_find_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118136_find_key, %set118136_query
  br i1 %set118136_find_equal, label %set118136_find_match, label %set118136_find_fallback
set118136_find_match:
  br label %set118136_find_done
set118136_find_vacant:
  br label %set118136_find_done
set118136_find_fallback:
  %set118136_find_grouped_mask = sub i64 %set118136_capacity, 1
  %set118136_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118136_query_hash, %set118136_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118136_find_grouped_entry
set118136_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118136_find_grouped_group
set118136_find_grouped_group:
  %set118136_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118136_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118136_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118136_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118136_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118136_capacity, %set118136_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118136_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118136_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118136_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118136_find_grouped_probe, %set118136_capacity
  br i1 %set118136_find_grouped_active, label %set118136_find_grouped_body, label %set118136_find_grouped_miss
set118136_find_grouped_body:
  %set118136_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118136_find_grouped_start, %set118136_find_grouped_probe
  %set118136_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118136_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118136_find_grouped_mask
  %set118136_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_controls, i64 %set118136_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118136_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118136_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118136_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118136_h2, i64 0
  %set118136_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118136_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118136_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118136_find_grouped_controls, %set118136_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118136_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118136_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118136_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118136_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118136_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118136_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118136_find_grouped_controls, %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118136_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118136_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118136_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118136_capacity
  %set118136_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118136_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118136_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64
  %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118136_find_grouped_group_start, %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118136_find_grouped_mask
  %set118136_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118136_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118136_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118136_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118136_find_grouped_candidates
set118136_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118136_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118136_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118136_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118136_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118136_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118136_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118136_find_grouped_decision
set118136_find_grouped_candidate:
  %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118136_find_grouped_group_start, %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118136_find_grouped_mask
  %set118136_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118136_keys, i64 %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_slot
  %set118136_find_grouped_key = load i32, ptr %set118136_find_grouped_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118136_find_grouped_key, %set118136_query
  br i1 %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_equal, label %set118136_find_grouped_match, label %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_next
set118136_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118136_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118136_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118136_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118136_find_grouped_candidates
set118136_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118136_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118136_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118136_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118136_find_grouped_empty, label %set118136_find_grouped_next_group

  %set118136_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118136_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118136_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118136_find_grouped_group_start, %set118136_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118136_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118136_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118136_find_grouped_mask
  %set118136_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118136_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118136_capacity
  %set118136_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118136_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118136_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118136_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118136_find_grouped_done
set118136_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118136_find_grouped_done
set118136_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118136_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118136_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118136_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118136_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118136_find_grouped_group
set118136_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118136_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118136_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118136_capacity
  %set118136_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118136_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118136_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118136_find_grouped_done
set118136_find_grouped_done:
  %set118136_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118136_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118136_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118136_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118136_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118136_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118136_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118136_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118136_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118136_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118136_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118136_find_done
set118136_find_done:
  %set118136_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118136_find_match ], [ false, %set118136_find_vacant ], [ %set118136_find_grouped_found, %set118136_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118136_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118136_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118136_find_start, %set118136_find_match ], [ %set118136_find_start, %set118136_find_vacant ], [ %set118136_find_grouped_slot, %set118136_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118136_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118136_slot = add i64 %set118136_find_slot, 0
  br i1 %set118136_find_found, label %set118136_found, label %set118136_missing
set118136_missing:
  %set118136_insert_slot = add i64 %set118136_find_slot, 0
  %set118136_next_length = add i64 %set118136_length, 1
  %set118136_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118136_next_length, 8
  %set118136_load_limit = mul i64 %set118136_capacity, 7
  %set118136_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118136_scaled_length, %set118136_load_limit
  br i1 %set118136_fits, label %set118136_insert_current, label %set118136_grow
set118136_insert_current:
  %set118136_insert_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118136_keys, i64 %set118136_insert_slot
  store i32 %set118136_query, ptr %set118136_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118136_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_controls, i64 %set118136_insert_slot
  %set118136_insert_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_controls, i64 %set118136_insert_slot
  store i8 %set118136_h2, ptr %set118136_insert_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118136_insert_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118136_insert_slot, 16
  %set118136_insert_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118136_insert_slot, %set118136_capacity
  %set118136_insert_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118136_insert_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118136_insert_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118136_insert_slot
  %set118136_insert_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_controls, i64 %set118136_insert_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118136_h2, ptr %set118136_insert_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  %set118136_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118136_source, i64 %set118136_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118136_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118136_inserted
set118136_grow:
  %set118136_grown_capacity = mul i64 %set118136_capacity, 2
  br label %set118136_grow_rehash_entry
set118136_grow_rehash_entry:
  %set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror = add i64 %set118136_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8
  %set118136_grow_rehash_entry_bytes = mul i64 %set118136_grown_capacity, 4
  %set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes = add i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_offset, %set118136_grow_rehash_entry_bytes
  %set118136_grow_rehash_storage = call ptr @malloc(i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes)
  %set118136_grow_rehash_allocated = icmp ne ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_storage, null
  br i1 %set118136_grow_rehash_allocated, label %set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_ready, label %set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_failed
set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_failed:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_ready:
  %set118136_grow_rehash_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_storage, i64 0
  %set118136_grow_rehash_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118136_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118136_grow_rehash_entries_offset = and i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118136_grow_rehash_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_storage, i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_entries_offset
  %set118136_grow_rehash_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_keys, i64 4
  %set118136_grow_rehash_control_bytes = add i64 %set118136_grown_capacity, 16
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_controls, i8 0, i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_control_bytes, i1 false)
  br label %set118136_grow_rehash_loop
set118136_grow_rehash_loop:
  %set118136_grow_rehash_index = phi i64 [ 0, %set118136_grow_rehash_allocation_ready ], [ %set118136_grow_rehash_next_index, %set118136_grow_rehash_advance ]
  %set118136_grow_rehash_active = icmp ult i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_index, %set118136_capacity
  br i1 %set118136_grow_rehash_active, label %set118136_grow_rehash_check, label %set118136_grow_rehash_done

  %set118136_grow_rehash_old_control = load i8, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118136_grow_rehash_occupied = icmp sgt i8 %set118136_grow_rehash_old_control, 0

set118136_grow_rehash_move:

  %set118136_grow_rehash_key = load i32, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr, align 4

  %set118136_grow_rehash_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_key64, 32

  %set118136_grow_rehash_hash = mul i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131

  %set118136_grow_rehash_h2_raw = and i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118136_grow_rehash_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_h2_raw, 0
  %set118136_grow_rehash_h2_value = select i1 %set118136_grow_rehash_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_h2_raw
  %set118136_grow_rehash_h2 = trunc i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_h2_value to i8

  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_start = and i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_hash, %set118136_grow_rehash_find_mask
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118136_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118136_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity, label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_first, label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity
set118136_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_done
set118136_grow_rehash_find_first:
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr, align 1

  br i1 %set118136_grow_rehash_find_h2_match, label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_compare, label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_fallback

  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr, align 4

  br i1 %set118136_grow_rehash_find_equal, label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_match, label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_fallback

  br label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_done

  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_hash, %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask

  br label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group:
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118136_grown_capacity, %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, %set118136_grown_capacity
  br i1 %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active, label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body, label %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss
set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118136_grow_rehash_h2, i64 0
  %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118136_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer

  %set118151_load_limit = mul i64 %set118151_capacity, 7
  %set118151_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118151_scaled_length, %set118151_load_limit
  br i1 %set118151_fits, label %set118151_insert_current, label %set118151_grow
set118151_insert_current:
  %set118151_insert_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118151_keys, i64 %set118151_insert_slot
  store i32 %set118151_query, ptr %set118151_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118151_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_controls, i64 %set118151_insert_slot
  %set118151_insert_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_controls, i64 %set118151_insert_slot
  store i8 %set118151_h2, ptr %set118151_insert_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118151_insert_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118151_insert_slot, 16
  %set118151_insert_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118151_insert_slot, %set118151_capacity
  %set118151_insert_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118151_insert_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118151_insert_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118151_insert_slot
  %set118151_insert_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_controls, i64 %set118151_insert_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118151_h2, ptr %set118151_insert_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  %set118151_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118151_source, i64 %set118151_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118151_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118151_inserted
set118151_grow:
  %set118151_grown_capacity = mul i64 %set118151_capacity, 2
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_entry
set118151_grow_rehash_entry:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror = add i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8
  %set118151_grow_rehash_entry_bytes = mul i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 4
  %set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_offset, %set118151_grow_rehash_entry_bytes
  %set118151_grow_rehash_storage = call ptr @malloc(i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes)
  %set118151_grow_rehash_allocated = icmp ne ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_storage, null
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_allocated, label %set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_ready, label %set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_failed
set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_failed:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_ready:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_storage, i64 0
  %set118151_grow_rehash_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118151_grow_rehash_entries_offset = and i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118151_grow_rehash_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_storage, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_entries_offset
  %set118151_grow_rehash_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_keys, i64 4
  %set118151_grow_rehash_control_bytes = add i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 16
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_controls, i8 0, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_control_bytes, i1 false)
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_loop
set118151_grow_rehash_loop:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_index = phi i64 [ 0, %set118151_grow_rehash_allocation_ready ], [ %set118151_grow_rehash_next_index, %set118151_grow_rehash_advance ]
  %set118151_grow_rehash_active = icmp ult i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_index, %set118151_capacity
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_active, label %set118151_grow_rehash_check, label %set118151_grow_rehash_done
set118151_grow_rehash_check:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_controls, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_index
  %set118151_grow_rehash_old_control = load i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118151_grow_rehash_occupied = icmp sgt i8 %set118151_grow_rehash_old_control, 0
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_occupied, label %set118151_grow_rehash_move, label %set118151_grow_rehash_advance
set118151_grow_rehash_move:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118151_keys, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_index
  %set118151_grow_rehash_key = load i32, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118151_grow_rehash_key64 = sext i32 %set118151_grow_rehash_key to i64
  %set118151_grow_rehash_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_key64, 32
  %set118151_grow_rehash_hash_fold = xor i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_key64, %set118151_grow_rehash_hash_high
  %set118151_grow_rehash_hash = mul i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131
  %set118151_grow_rehash_h2_shifted = lshr i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_hash, 57
  %set118151_grow_rehash_h2_raw = and i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118151_grow_rehash_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_h2_raw, 0
  %set118151_grow_rehash_h2_value = select i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_h2_raw
  %set118151_grow_rehash_h2 = trunc i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_h2_value to i8
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_mask = sub i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_start = and i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_hash, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_mask
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_first, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity
set118151_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_done
set118151_grow_rehash_find_first:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_empty = icmp eq i8 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_control, 0
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_empty, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_vacant, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_occupied
set118151_grow_rehash_find_occupied:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_control, %set118151_grow_rehash_h2
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_h2_match, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_compare, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118151_grow_rehash_find_compare:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_key, %set118151_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_equal, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_match, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118151_grow_rehash_find_match:
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_done
set118151_grow_rehash_find_vacant:
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_done
set118151_grow_rehash_find_fallback:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask = sub i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_hash, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118151_grown_capacity, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, %set118151_grown_capacity
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118151_grow_rehash_h2, i64 0
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118151_grown_capacity
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key = load i32, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key, %set118151_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_equal, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty, label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118151_grown_capacity
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118151_grown_capacity
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_find_done
set118151_grow_rehash_find_done:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_match ], [ false, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_vacant ], [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_found, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118151_grow_rehash_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_start, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_match ], [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_start, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_vacant ], [ %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_slot, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118151_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118151_grow_rehash_slot = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_find_slot, 0
  %set118151_grow_rehash_new_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_slot
  store i32 %set118151_grow_rehash_key, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_new_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_slot
  store i8 %set118151_grow_rehash_h2, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_slot, 16
  %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_slot, %set118151_grown_capacity
  %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_slot
  %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118151_grow_rehash_h2, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_advance
set118151_grow_rehash_advance:
  %set118151_grow_rehash_next_index = add i64 %set118151_grow_rehash_index, 1
  br label %set118151_grow_rehash_loop
set118151_grow_rehash_done:
  call void @free(ptr %set118151_controls)
  %set118151_grow_rehash_result_0 = insertvalue %sollang.dict poison, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_storage, 0
  %set118151_grow_rehash_result_1 = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118151_grow_rehash_result_0, i64 %set118151_length, 1
  %set118151_grow_rehash_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118151_grow_rehash_result_1, i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 2
  %set118151_grown_probe_mask = sub i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118151_grown_probe_start = and i64 %set118151_query_hash, %set118151_grown_probe_mask
  %set118151_grown_probe_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118151_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118151_grown_probe_has_capacity, label %set118151_grown_probe_first, label %set118151_grown_probe_no_capacity
set118151_grown_probe_no_capacity:
  br label %set118151_grown_probe_done
set118151_grown_probe_first:
  %set118151_grown_probe_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118151_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118151_grown_probe_start
  %set118151_grown_probe_control = load i8, ptr %set118151_grown_probe_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118151_grown_probe_empty = icmp eq i8 %set118151_grown_probe_control, 0
  br i1 %set118151_grown_probe_empty, label %set118151_grown_probe_vacant, label %set118151_grown_probe_occupied
set118151_grown_probe_occupied:
  %set118151_grown_probe_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118151_grown_probe_control, %set118151_h2
  br i1 %set118151_grown_probe_h2_match, label %set118151_grown_probe_compare, label %set118151_grown_probe_fallback

set118154_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118154_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118154_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118154_capacity
  %set118154_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118154_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118154_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118154_find_grouped_done
set118154_find_grouped_done:
  %set118154_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118154_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118154_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118154_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118154_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118154_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118154_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118154_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118154_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118154_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118154_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118154_find_done
set118154_find_done:
  %set118154_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118154_find_match ], [ false, %set118154_find_vacant ], [ %set118154_find_grouped_found, %set118154_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118154_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118154_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118154_find_start, %set118154_find_match ], [ %set118154_find_start, %set118154_find_vacant ], [ %set118154_find_grouped_slot, %set118154_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118154_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118154_slot = add i64 %set118154_find_slot, 0
  br i1 %set118154_find_found, label %set118154_found, label %set118154_missing
set118154_missing:
  %set118154_insert_slot = add i64 %set118154_find_slot, 0
  %set118154_next_length = add i64 %set118154_length, 1
  %set118154_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118154_next_length, 8
  %set118154_load_limit = mul i64 %set118154_capacity, 7
  %set118154_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118154_scaled_length, %set118154_load_limit
  br i1 %set118154_fits, label %set118154_insert_current, label %set118154_grow
set118154_insert_current:
  %set118154_insert_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118154_keys, i64 %set118154_insert_slot
  store i32 %set118154_query, ptr %set118154_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118154_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_controls, i64 %set118154_insert_slot
  %set118154_insert_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_controls, i64 %set118154_insert_slot
  store i8 %set118154_h2, ptr %set118154_insert_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118154_insert_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118154_insert_slot, 16
  %set118154_insert_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118154_insert_slot, %set118154_capacity
  %set118154_insert_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118154_insert_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118154_insert_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118154_insert_slot
  %set118154_insert_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_controls, i64 %set118154_insert_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118154_h2, ptr %set118154_insert_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  %set118154_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118154_source, i64 %set118154_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118154_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118154_inserted
set118154_grow:
  %set118154_grown_capacity = mul i64 %set118154_capacity, 2
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_entry
set118154_grow_rehash_entry:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror = add i64 %set118154_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8
  %set118154_grow_rehash_entry_bytes = mul i64 %set118154_grown_capacity, 4
  %set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_offset, %set118154_grow_rehash_entry_bytes
  %set118154_grow_rehash_storage = call ptr @malloc(i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes)
  %set118154_grow_rehash_allocated = icmp ne ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_storage, null
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_allocated, label %set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_ready, label %set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_failed
set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_failed:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_ready:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_storage, i64 0
  %set118154_grow_rehash_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118154_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118154_grow_rehash_entries_offset = and i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118154_grow_rehash_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_storage, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_entries_offset
  %set118154_grow_rehash_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_keys, i64 4
  %set118154_grow_rehash_control_bytes = add i64 %set118154_grown_capacity, 16
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_controls, i8 0, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_control_bytes, i1 false)
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_loop
set118154_grow_rehash_loop:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_index = phi i64 [ 0, %set118154_grow_rehash_allocation_ready ], [ %set118154_grow_rehash_next_index, %set118154_grow_rehash_advance ]
  %set118154_grow_rehash_active = icmp ult i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_index, %set118154_capacity
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_active, label %set118154_grow_rehash_check, label %set118154_grow_rehash_done
set118154_grow_rehash_check:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_controls, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_index
  %set118154_grow_rehash_old_control = load i8, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118154_grow_rehash_occupied = icmp sgt i8 %set118154_grow_rehash_old_control, 0
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_occupied, label %set118154_grow_rehash_move, label %set118154_grow_rehash_advance
set118154_grow_rehash_move:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118154_keys, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_index
  %set118154_grow_rehash_key = load i32, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118154_grow_rehash_key64 = sext i32 %set118154_grow_rehash_key to i64
  %set118154_grow_rehash_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_key64, 32
  %set118154_grow_rehash_hash_fold = xor i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_key64, %set118154_grow_rehash_hash_high
  %set118154_grow_rehash_hash = mul i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131
  %set118154_grow_rehash_h2_shifted = lshr i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_hash, 57
  %set118154_grow_rehash_h2_raw = and i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118154_grow_rehash_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_h2_raw, 0
  %set118154_grow_rehash_h2_value = select i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_h2_raw
  %set118154_grow_rehash_h2 = trunc i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_h2_value to i8
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_mask = sub i64 %set118154_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_start = and i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_hash, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_mask
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118154_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_first, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity
set118154_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_done
set118154_grow_rehash_find_first:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_empty = icmp eq i8 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_control, 0
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_empty, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_vacant, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_occupied
set118154_grow_rehash_find_occupied:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_control, %set118154_grow_rehash_h2
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_h2_match, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_compare, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118154_grow_rehash_find_compare:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_key, %set118154_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_equal, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_match, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118154_grow_rehash_find_match:
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_done
set118154_grow_rehash_find_vacant:
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_done
set118154_grow_rehash_find_fallback:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask = sub i64 %set118154_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_hash, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118154_grown_capacity, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, %set118154_grown_capacity
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118154_grow_rehash_h2, i64 0
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118154_grown_capacity
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key = load i32, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key, %set118154_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_equal, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty, label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118154_grown_capacity
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss:

  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done:

  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_find_done
set118154_grow_rehash_find_done:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_match ], [ false, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_vacant ], [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_found, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118154_grow_rehash_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_start, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_match ], [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_start, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_vacant ], [ %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_slot, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118154_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118154_grow_rehash_slot = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_find_slot, 0
  %set118154_grow_rehash_new_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_slot
  store i32 %set118154_grow_rehash_key, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_new_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_slot
  store i8 %set118154_grow_rehash_h2, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_slot, 16
  %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_slot, %set118154_grown_capacity
  %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_slot
  %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118154_grow_rehash_h2, ptr %set118154_grow_rehash_store_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_advance
set118154_grow_rehash_advance:
  %set118154_grow_rehash_next_index = add i64 %set118154_grow_rehash_index, 1
  br label %set118154_grow_rehash_loop
