  %set118157_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118157_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118157_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118157_find_grouped_candidates
set118157_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118157_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118157_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118157_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118157_find_grouped_empty, label %set118157_find_grouped_next_group
set118157_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118157_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118157_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118157_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118157_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118157_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118157_find_grouped_group_start, %set118157_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118157_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118157_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118157_find_grouped_mask
  %set118157_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118157_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118157_capacity
  %set118157_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118157_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118157_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118157_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118157_find_grouped_done
set118157_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118157_find_grouped_done
set118157_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118157_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118157_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118157_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118157_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118157_find_grouped_group
set118157_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118157_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118157_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118157_capacity
  %set118157_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118157_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118157_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118157_find_grouped_done
set118157_find_grouped_done:
  %set118157_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118157_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118157_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118157_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118157_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118157_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118157_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118157_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118157_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118157_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118157_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118157_find_done
set118157_find_done:
  %set118157_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118157_find_match ], [ false, %set118157_find_vacant ], [ %set118157_find_grouped_found, %set118157_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118157_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118157_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118157_find_start, %set118157_find_match ], [ %set118157_find_start, %set118157_find_vacant ], [ %set118157_find_grouped_slot, %set118157_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118157_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118157_slot = add i64 %set118157_find_slot, 0
  br i1 %set118157_find_found, label %set118157_found, label %set118157_missing
set118157_missing:
  %set118157_insert_slot = add i64 %set118157_find_slot, 0
  %set118157_next_length = add i64 %set118157_length, 1
  %set118157_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118157_next_length, 8
  %set118157_load_limit = mul i64 %set118157_capacity, 7
  %set118157_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118157_scaled_length, %set118157_load_limit
  br i1 %set118157_fits, label %set118157_insert_current, label %set118157_grow
set118157_insert_current:
  %set118157_insert_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118157_keys, i64 %set118157_insert_slot
  store i32 %set118157_query, ptr %set118157_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118157_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118157_controls, i64 %set118157_insert_slot
  %set118157_insert_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118157_controls, i64 %set118157_insert_slot
  store i8 %set118157_h2, ptr %set118157_insert_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118157_insert_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118157_insert_slot, 16
  %set118157_insert_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118157_insert_slot, %set118157_capacity
  %set118157_insert_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118157_insert_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118157_insert_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118157_insert_slot
  %set118157_insert_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118157_controls, i64 %set118157_insert_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118157_h2, ptr %set118157_insert_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  %set118157_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118157_source, i64 %set118157_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118157_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118157_inserted
set118157_grow:
  %set118157_grown_capacity = mul i64 %set118157_capacity, 2
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_entry
set118157_grow_rehash_entry:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror = add i64 %set118157_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8
  %set118157_grow_rehash_entry_bytes = mul i64 %set118157_grown_capacity, 4
  %set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes = add i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_offset, %set118157_grow_rehash_entry_bytes
  %set118157_grow_rehash_storage = call ptr @malloc(i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes)
  %set118157_grow_rehash_allocated = icmp ne ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_storage, null
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_allocated, label %set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_ready, label %set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_failed
set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_failed:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_ready:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_storage, i64 0
  %set118157_grow_rehash_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118157_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118157_grow_rehash_entries_offset = and i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118157_grow_rehash_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_storage, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_entries_offset
  %set118157_grow_rehash_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_keys, i64 4
  %set118157_grow_rehash_control_bytes = add i64 %set118157_grown_capacity, 16
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_controls, i8 0, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_control_bytes, i1 false)
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_loop
set118157_grow_rehash_loop:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_index = phi i64 [ 0, %set118157_grow_rehash_allocation_ready ], [ %set118157_grow_rehash_next_index, %set118157_grow_rehash_advance ]
  %set118157_grow_rehash_active = icmp ult i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_index, %set118157_capacity
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_active, label %set118157_grow_rehash_check, label %set118157_grow_rehash_done
set118157_grow_rehash_check:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118157_controls, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_index
  %set118157_grow_rehash_old_control = load i8, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118157_grow_rehash_occupied = icmp sgt i8 %set118157_grow_rehash_old_control, 0
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_occupied, label %set118157_grow_rehash_move, label %set118157_grow_rehash_advance
set118157_grow_rehash_move:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118157_keys, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_index
  %set118157_grow_rehash_key = load i32, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118157_grow_rehash_key64 = sext i32 %set118157_grow_rehash_key to i64
  %set118157_grow_rehash_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_key64, 32
  %set118157_grow_rehash_hash_fold = xor i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_key64, %set118157_grow_rehash_hash_high
  %set118157_grow_rehash_hash = mul i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131
  %set118157_grow_rehash_h2_shifted = lshr i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_hash, 57
  %set118157_grow_rehash_h2_raw = and i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118157_grow_rehash_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_h2_raw, 0
  %set118157_grow_rehash_h2_value = select i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_h2_raw
  %set118157_grow_rehash_h2 = trunc i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_h2_value to i8
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_mask = sub i64 %set118157_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_start = and i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_hash, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_mask
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118157_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_first, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity
set118157_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_done
set118157_grow_rehash_find_first:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_empty = icmp eq i8 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_control, 0
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_empty, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_vacant, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_occupied
set118157_grow_rehash_find_occupied:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_control, %set118157_grow_rehash_h2
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_h2_match, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_compare, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118157_grow_rehash_find_compare:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_key, %set118157_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_equal, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_match, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118157_grow_rehash_find_match:
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_done
set118157_grow_rehash_find_vacant:
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_done
set118157_grow_rehash_find_fallback:

  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_hash, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry
set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118157_grown_capacity, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, %set118157_grown_capacity
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss
set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118157_grow_rehash_h2, i64 0
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118157_grown_capacity
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision

  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset

set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty, label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group
set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty:

  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118157_grown_capacity
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted

  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0

  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done
set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_done:
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118157_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118157_grow_rehash_find_done

  %set118160_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118160_find_grouped_group_start, %set118160_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118160_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118160_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118160_find_grouped_mask
  %set118160_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118160_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118160_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118160_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118160_find_grouped_candidates
set118160_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118160_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118160_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118160_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118160_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118160_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118160_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118160_find_grouped_decision
set118160_find_grouped_candidate:
  %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118160_find_grouped_group_start, %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118160_find_grouped_mask
  %set118160_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118160_keys, i64 %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_slot
  %set118160_find_grouped_key = load i32, ptr %set118160_find_grouped_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118160_find_grouped_key, %set118160_query
  br i1 %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_equal, label %set118160_find_grouped_match, label %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_next
set118160_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118160_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118160_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118160_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118160_find_grouped_candidates
set118160_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118160_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118160_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118160_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118160_find_grouped_empty, label %set118160_find_grouped_next_group
set118160_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118160_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118160_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118160_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118160_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118160_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118160_find_grouped_group_start, %set118160_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118160_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118160_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118160_find_grouped_mask
  %set118160_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118160_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118160_capacity
  %set118160_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118160_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118160_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118160_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118160_find_grouped_done
set118160_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118160_find_grouped_done
set118160_find_grouped_next_group:
  %set118160_find_grouped_next_probe = add i64 %set118160_find_grouped_probe, 16
  %set118160_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118160_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118160_find_grouped_group
set118160_find_grouped_miss:
  %set118160_find_grouped_no_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118160_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118160_capacity
  %set118160_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118160_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118160_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118160_find_grouped_done
set118160_find_grouped_done:
  %set118160_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118160_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118160_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118160_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118160_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118160_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118160_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118160_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118160_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118160_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118160_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118160_find_done
set118160_find_done:
  %set118160_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118160_find_match ], [ false, %set118160_find_vacant ], [ %set118160_find_grouped_found, %set118160_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118160_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118160_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118160_find_start, %set118160_find_match ], [ %set118160_find_start, %set118160_find_vacant ], [ %set118160_find_grouped_slot, %set118160_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118160_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118160_slot = add i64 %set118160_find_slot, 0
  br i1 %set118160_find_found, label %set118160_found, label %set118160_missing
set118160_missing:
  %set118160_insert_slot = add i64 %set118160_find_slot, 0
  %set118160_next_length = add i64 %set118160_length, 1
  %set118160_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118160_next_length, 8
  %set118160_load_limit = mul i64 %set118160_capacity, 7
  %set118160_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118160_scaled_length, %set118160_load_limit
  br i1 %set118160_fits, label %set118160_insert_current, label %set118160_grow
set118160_insert_current:
  %set118160_insert_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118160_keys, i64 %set118160_insert_slot
  store i32 %set118160_query, ptr %set118160_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118160_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118160_controls, i64 %set118160_insert_slot
  %set118160_insert_control_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118160_controls, i64 %set118160_insert_slot
  store i8 %set118160_h2, ptr %set118160_insert_control_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118160_insert_control_mirror_needed = icmp ult i64 %set118160_insert_slot, 16
  %set118160_insert_control_mirror_candidate = add i64 %set118160_insert_slot, %set118160_capacity
  %set118160_insert_control_mirror_slot = select i1 %set118160_insert_control_mirror_needed, i64 %set118160_insert_control_mirror_candidate, i64 %set118160_insert_slot
  %set118160_insert_control_mirror_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118160_controls, i64 %set118160_insert_control_mirror_slot
  store i8 %set118160_h2, ptr %set118160_insert_control_mirror_ptr, align 1
  %set118160_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118160_source, i64 %set118160_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118160_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118160_inserted
set118160_grow:
  %set118160_grown_capacity = mul i64 %set118160_capacity, 2
  br label %set118160_grow_rehash_entry
set118160_grow_rehash_entry:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror = add i64 %set118160_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8
  %set118160_grow_rehash_entry_bytes = mul i64 %set118160_grown_capacity, 4
  %set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes = add i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_offset, %set118160_grow_rehash_entry_bytes
  %set118160_grow_rehash_storage = call ptr @malloc(i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_bytes)
  %set118160_grow_rehash_allocated = icmp ne ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_storage, null
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_allocated, label %set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_ready, label %set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_failed
set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_failed:
  call void @llvm.trap()
  unreachable
set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_ready:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_controls = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_storage, i64 0
  %set118160_grow_rehash_entries_mirror = add i64 %set118160_grown_capacity, 23
  %set118160_grow_rehash_entries_offset = and i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_entries_mirror, -8
  %set118160_grow_rehash_keys = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_storage, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_entries_offset
  %set118160_grow_rehash_values = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_keys, i64 4
  %set118160_grow_rehash_control_bytes = add i64 %set118160_grown_capacity, 16
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_controls, i8 0, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_control_bytes, i1 false)
  br label %set118160_grow_rehash_loop
set118160_grow_rehash_loop:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_index = phi i64 [ 0, %set118160_grow_rehash_allocation_ready ], [ %set118160_grow_rehash_next_index, %set118160_grow_rehash_advance ]
  %set118160_grow_rehash_active = icmp ult i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_index, %set118160_capacity
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_active, label %set118160_grow_rehash_check, label %set118160_grow_rehash_done
set118160_grow_rehash_check:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118160_controls, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_index
  %set118160_grow_rehash_old_control = load i8, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_old_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118160_grow_rehash_occupied = icmp sgt i8 %set118160_grow_rehash_old_control, 0
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_occupied, label %set118160_grow_rehash_move, label %set118160_grow_rehash_advance
set118160_grow_rehash_move:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %set118160_keys, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_index
  %set118160_grow_rehash_key = load i32, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_old_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118160_grow_rehash_key64 = sext i32 %set118160_grow_rehash_key to i64
  %set118160_grow_rehash_hash_high = lshr i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_key64, 32
  %set118160_grow_rehash_hash_fold = xor i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_key64, %set118160_grow_rehash_hash_high
  %set118160_grow_rehash_hash = mul i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_hash_fold, -7046029254386353131
  %set118160_grow_rehash_h2_shifted = lshr i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_hash, 57
  %set118160_grow_rehash_h2_raw = and i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_h2_shifted, 127
  %set118160_grow_rehash_h2_zero = icmp eq i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_h2_raw, 0
  %set118160_grow_rehash_h2_value = select i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_h2_zero, i64 1, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_h2_raw
  %set118160_grow_rehash_h2 = trunc i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_h2_value to i8
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_mask = sub i64 %set118160_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_start = and i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_hash, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_mask
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity = icmp ugt i64 %set118160_grown_capacity, 0
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_has_capacity, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_first, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity
set118160_grow_rehash_find_no_capacity:
  br label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_done
set118160_grow_rehash_find_first:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_control = load i8, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_find_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_empty = icmp eq i8 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_control, 0
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_empty, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_vacant, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_occupied
set118160_grow_rehash_find_occupied:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_h2_match = icmp eq i8 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_control, %set118160_grow_rehash_h2
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_h2_match, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_compare, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118160_grow_rehash_find_compare:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_start
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_key = load i32, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_find_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_key, %set118160_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_equal, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_match, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_fallback
set118160_grow_rehash_find_match:
  br label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_done
set118160_grow_rehash_find_vacant:
  br label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_done
set118160_grow_rehash_find_fallback:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask = sub i64 %set118160_grown_capacity, 1
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start = and i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_hash, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  br label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry
set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry:
  br label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group
set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe = phi i64 [ 0, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_probe, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted = phi i64 [ %set118160_grown_capacity, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_entry ], [ %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_deleted, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group ]
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active = icmp ult i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe, %set118160_grown_capacity
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_active, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_miss
set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped = add i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_start, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_probe
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start = and i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_unwrapped, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_controls, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls = load <16 x i8>, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_control_ptr, align 1
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 %set118160_grow_rehash_h2, i64 0
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_h2_vector
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_matches to i16
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, zeroinitializer
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empties to i16
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed = insertelement <16 x i8> poison, i8 -1, i64 0
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector = shufflevector <16 x i8> %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_seed, <16 x i8> poison, <16 x i32> zeroinitializer
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches = icmp eq <16 x i8> %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_controls, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_vector
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_matches to i16
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118160_grown_capacity
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_bits, i1 false)
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset = zext i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset16 to i64
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped = add i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_offset
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot = and i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_unwrapped, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_captured_deleted = select i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_capture_deleted, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_deleted_slot, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits = phi i16 [ %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match_bits, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_body ], [ %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next ]
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_candidate, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision
set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, i1 false)
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset = zext i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset16 to i64
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped = add i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_offset
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot = and i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_unwrapped, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key_ptr = getelementptr [4 x i8], ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_keys, i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_slot
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key = load i32, ptr %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_equal = icmp eq i32 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_key, %set118160_grow_rehash_key
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_equal, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_match, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next
set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_next:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one = sub i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 1
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_candidates
set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_decision:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty = icmp ne i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, 0
  br i1 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty, label %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_next_group
set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty:
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 = call i16 @llvm.cttz.i16(i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_bits, i1 false)
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset = zext i16 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset16 to i64
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped = add i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_group_start, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_offset
  %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_slot = and i64 %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_empty_unwrapped, %set118160_grow_rehash_find_grouped_mask

  %set118163_find_grouped_empty_bits = bitcast <16 x i1> %set118163_find_grouped_empties to i16

  %set118163_find_grouped_has_deleted = icmp ne i16 %set118163_find_grouped_deleted_bits, 0
  %set118163_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted = icmp eq i64 %set118163_find_grouped_first_deleted, %set118163_capacity
  %set118163_find_grouped_capture_deleted = and i1 %set118163_find_grouped_has_deleted, %set118163_find_grouped_no_previous_deleted

  br label %set118163_find_grouped_candidates

  %set118163_find_grouped_has_candidate = icmp ne i16 %set118163_find_grouped_candidate_bits, 0

  %set118163_find_grouped_cleared_bits = and i16 %set118163_find_grouped_candidate_bits, %set118163_find_grouped_bits_minus_one
  br label %set118163_find_grouped_candidates

  br i1 %set118163_find_grouped_has_empty, label %set118163_find_grouped_empty, label %set118163_find_grouped_next_group

  %set118163_find_grouped_use_empty = icmp eq i64 %set118163_find_grouped_captured_deleted, %set118163_capacity
  %set118163_find_grouped_insertion_slot = select i1 %set118163_find_grouped_use_empty, i64 %set118163_find_grouped_empty_slot, i64 %set118163_find_grouped_captured_deleted
  br label %set118163_find_grouped_done
set118163_find_grouped_match:
  br label %set118163_find_grouped_done

  %set118163_find_grouped_next_deleted = add i64 %set118163_find_grouped_captured_deleted, 0
  br label %set118163_find_grouped_group
set118163_find_grouped_miss:

  %set118163_find_grouped_miss_slot = select i1 %set118163_find_grouped_no_deleted, i64 0, i64 %set118163_find_grouped_first_deleted
  br label %set118163_find_grouped_done
set118163_find_grouped_done:
  %set118163_find_grouped_found = phi i1 [ false, %set118163_find_grouped_empty ], [ true, %set118163_find_grouped_match ], [ false, %set118163_find_grouped_miss ]
  %set118163_find_grouped_slot = phi i64 [ %set118163_find_grouped_insertion_slot, %set118163_find_grouped_empty ], [ %set118163_find_grouped_candidate_slot, %set118163_find_grouped_match ], [ %set118163_find_grouped_miss_slot, %set118163_find_grouped_miss ]
  br label %set118163_find_done
set118163_find_done:
  %set118163_find_found = phi i1 [ true, %set118163_find_match ], [ false, %set118163_find_vacant ], [ %set118163_find_grouped_found, %set118163_find_grouped_done ], [ false, %set118163_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118163_find_slot = phi i64 [ %set118163_find_start, %set118163_find_match ], [ %set118163_find_start, %set118163_find_vacant ], [ %set118163_find_grouped_slot, %set118163_find_grouped_done ], [ 0, %set118163_find_no_capacity ]
  %set118163_slot = add i64 %set118163_find_slot, 0
  br i1 %set118163_find_found, label %set118163_found, label %set118163_missing
set118163_missing:
  %set118163_insert_slot = add i64 %set118163_find_slot, 0
  %set118163_next_length = add i64 %set118163_length, 1
  %set118163_scaled_length = mul i64 %set118163_next_length, 8
  %set118163_load_limit = mul i64 %set118163_capacity, 7
  %set118163_fits = icmp ule i64 %set118163_scaled_length, %set118163_load_limit

set118163_insert_current:

  store i32 %set118163_query, ptr %set118163_insert_key_ptr, align 4
  %set118163_insert_control_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %set118163_controls, i64 %set118163_insert_slot

  %set118163_current_result = insertvalue %sollang.dict %set118163_source, i64 %set118163_next_length, 1
  store %sollang.dict %set118163_current_result, ptr %arg_mut_struct, align 8
  br label %set118163_inserted
set118163_grow:

  %set118163_grow_rehash_allocation_offset = and i64 %set118163_grow_rehash_allocation_mirror, -8

define internal ptr @sollang_process_copy_text(ptr %data, i64 %length) {
entry:
  %capacity = add i64 %length, 1
  %copy = call ptr @malloc(i64 %capacity)
  %allocated = icmp ne ptr %copy, null
  br i1 %allocated, label %loop, label %fail
loop:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %body ]
  %done = icmp eq i64 %index, %length
  br i1 %done, label %terminate, label %body
body:
  %source = getelementptr i8, ptr %data, i64 %index
  %byte = load i8, ptr %source, align 1
  %destination = getelementptr i8, ptr %copy, i64 %index
  store i8 %byte, ptr %destination, align 1
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  br label %loop
terminate:
  %null_slot = getelementptr i8, ptr %copy, i64 %length
  store i8 0, ptr %null_slot, align 1
  ret ptr %copy
fail:
  ret ptr null
}
define internal void @sollang_process_dispose_argv(ptr %argv, i64 %count) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %body ]
  %done = icmp eq i64 %index, %count
  br i1 %done, label %finish, label %body
body:
  %slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %argv, i64 %index
  %value = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 8
  call void @free(ptr %value)
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  br label %loop
finish:
  call void @free(ptr %argv)
  ret void
}
define internal ptr @sollang_process_build_argv(ptr %records, i64 %count) {
entry:
  %slots = add i64 %count, 1
  %bytes = mul i64 %slots, 8
  %argv = call ptr @malloc(i64 %bytes)
  %allocated = icmp ne ptr %argv, null
  br i1 %allocated, label %loop, label %fail
loop:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %stored ]
  %done = icmp eq i64 %index, %count
  br i1 %done, label %terminate, label %copy
copy:
  %record = getelementptr %sollang.text, ptr %records, i64 %index
  %data_slot = getelementptr inbounds %sollang.text, ptr %record, i32 0, i32 0
  %data = load ptr, ptr %data_slot, align 8
  %length_slot = getelementptr inbounds %sollang.text, ptr %record, i32 0, i32 1
  %length = load i64, ptr %length_slot, align 8
  %value = call ptr @sollang_process_copy_text(ptr %data, i64 %length)
  %copied = icmp ne ptr %value, null
  br i1 %copied, label %stored, label %cleanup
stored:
  %slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %argv, i64 %index
  store ptr %value, ptr %slot, align 8
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  br label %loop
cleanup:
  call void @sollang_process_dispose_argv(ptr %argv, i64 %index)
  ret ptr null
terminate:
  %null_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %argv, i64 %count
  store ptr null, ptr %null_slot, align 8
  ret ptr %argv
fail:
  ret ptr null
}
declare i64 @_get_osfhandle(i32)
define internal ptr @sollang_process_quote_windows_arg(ptr %source, i32 %chars) {
entry:
  %chars64 = zext i32 %chars to i64
  %double = mul i64 %chars64, 2
  %capacity = add i64 %double, 3
  %bytes = mul i64 %capacity, 2
  %output = call ptr @malloc(i64 %bytes)
  %allocated = icmp ne ptr %output, null
  br i1 %allocated, label %initialize, label %fail
initialize:
  store i16 34, ptr %output, align 2
  %index_slot = alloca i32, align 4
  %output_slot = alloca i64, align 8
  %slashes_slot = alloca i64, align 8
  store i32 0, ptr %index_slot, align 4
  store i64 1, ptr %output_slot, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %slashes_slot, align 8
  br label %loop
loop:
  %index = load i32, ptr %index_slot, align 4
  %done = icmp eq i32 %index, %chars
  br i1 %done, label %finish_prepare, label %read
read:
  %character_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %source, i32 %index
  %character = load i16, ptr %character_ptr, align 2
  %is_slash = icmp eq i16 %character, 92
  br i1 %is_slash, label %remember_slash, label %flush_prepare
remember_slash:
  %slashes = load i64, ptr %slashes_slot, align 8
  %more_slashes = add i64 %slashes, 1
  store i64 %more_slashes, ptr %slashes_slot, align 8
  %slash_next = add i32 %index, 1
  store i32 %slash_next, ptr %index_slot, align 4
  br label %loop
flush_prepare:
  %pending = load i64, ptr %slashes_slot, align 8
  %is_quote = icmp eq i16 %character, 34
  %doubled = mul i64 %pending, 2
  %escaped = add i64 %doubled, 1
  %flush_count = select i1 %is_quote, i64 %escaped, i64 %pending
  br label %flush_loop
flush_loop:
  %flush_index = phi i64 [ 0, %flush_prepare ], [ %flush_next, %flush_body ]
  %flush_done = icmp eq i64 %flush_index, %flush_count
  br i1 %flush_done, label %write_character, label %flush_body
flush_body:
  %flush_output = load i64, ptr %output_slot, align 8
  %flush_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %output, i64 %flush_output
  store i16 92, ptr %flush_ptr, align 2
  %flush_output_next = add i64 %flush_output, 1
  store i64 %flush_output_next, ptr %output_slot, align 8
  %flush_next = add i64 %flush_index, 1
  br label %flush_loop
write_character:
  %output_index = load i64, ptr %output_slot, align 8
  %output_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %output, i64 %output_index
  store i16 %character, ptr %output_ptr, align 2
  %output_next = add i64 %output_index, 1
  store i64 %output_next, ptr %output_slot, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %slashes_slot, align 8
  %index_next = add i32 %index, 1
  store i32 %index_next, ptr %index_slot, align 4
  br label %loop
finish_prepare:
  %trailing = load i64, ptr %slashes_slot, align 8
  %finish_count = mul i64 %trailing, 2
  br label %finish_loop
finish_loop:
  %finish_index = phi i64 [ 0, %finish_prepare ], [ %finish_next, %finish_body ]
  %finish_done = icmp eq i64 %finish_index, %finish_count
  br i1 %finish_done, label %close_quote, label %finish_body
finish_body:
  %finish_output = load i64, ptr %output_slot, align 8
  %finish_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %output, i64 %finish_output
  store i16 92, ptr %finish_ptr, align 2
  %finish_output_next = add i64 %finish_output, 1
  store i64 %finish_output_next, ptr %output_slot, align 8
  %finish_next = add i64 %finish_index, 1
  br label %finish_loop
close_quote:
  %close_index = load i64, ptr %output_slot, align 8
  %quote_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %output, i64 %close_index
  store i16 34, ptr %quote_ptr, align 2
  %null_index = add i64 %close_index, 1
  %null_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %output, i64 %null_index
  store i16 0, ptr %null_ptr, align 2
  ret ptr %output
fail:
  ret ptr null
}
define internal ptr @sollang_process_build_windows_argv(ptr %records, i64 %count, ptr %program_slot) {
entry:
  store ptr null, ptr %program_slot, align 8
  %slots = add i64 %count, 1
  %argv_bytes = mul i64 %slots, 8
  %argv = call ptr @malloc(i64 %argv_bytes)
  %allocated = icmp ne ptr %argv, null
  br i1 %allocated, label %loop, label %fail
loop:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %store ]
  %done = icmp eq i64 %index, %count
  br i1 %done, label %terminate, label %measure
measure:
  %record = getelementptr %sollang.text, ptr %records, i64 %index
  %data_slot = getelementptr inbounds %sollang.text, ptr %record, i32 0, i32 0
  %data = load ptr, ptr %data_slot, align 8
  %length_slot = getelementptr inbounds %sollang.text, ptr %record, i32 0, i32 1
  %length64 = load i64, ptr %length_slot, align 8
  %length_fits = icmp ule i64 %length64, 2147483647
  br i1 %length_fits, label %convert_size, label %cleanup
convert_size:
  %length = trunc i64 %length64 to i32
  %chars = call i32 @MultiByteToWideChar(i32 65001, i32 8, ptr %data, i32 %length, ptr null, i32 0)
  %chars_valid = icmp sgt i32 %chars, 0
  %empty = icmp eq i32 %length, 0
  %valid = or i1 %chars_valid, %empty
  br i1 %valid, label %allocate_wide, label %cleanup
allocate_wide:
  %chars_with_null = add i32 %chars, 1
  %chars_with_null64 = zext i32 %chars_with_null to i64
  %wide_bytes = mul i64 %chars_with_null64, 2
  %wide = call ptr @malloc(i64 %wide_bytes)
  %wide_ok = icmp ne ptr %wide, null
  br i1 %wide_ok, label %convert, label %cleanup
convert:
  %written = call i32 @MultiByteToWideChar(i32 65001, i32 8, ptr %data, i32 %length, ptr %wide, i32 %chars)
  %converted = icmp eq i32 %written, %chars
  br i1 %converted, label %terminate_wide, label %free_wide_error
terminate_wide:
  %wide_end = getelementptr i16, ptr %wide, i32 %chars
  store i16 0, ptr %wide_end, align 2
  %quoted = call ptr @sollang_process_quote_windows_arg(ptr %wide, i32 %chars)
  %quoted_ok = icmp ne ptr %quoted, null
  br i1 %quoted_ok, label %preserve_program, label %free_wide_error
preserve_program:
  %is_program = icmp eq i64 %index, 0
  br i1 %is_program, label %store_program, label %free_unquoted
store_program:
  store ptr %wide, ptr %program_slot, align 8
  br label %store
free_unquoted:
  call void @free(ptr %wide)
  br label %store
store:
  %slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %argv, i64 %index
  store ptr %quoted, ptr %slot, align 8
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  br label %loop
free_wide_error:
  call void @free(ptr %wide)
  br label %cleanup
cleanup:
  %failed_program = load ptr, ptr %program_slot, align 8
  call void @free(ptr %failed_program)
  store ptr null, ptr %program_slot, align 8
  call void @sollang_process_dispose_argv(ptr %argv, i64 %index)
  ret ptr null
terminate:
  %null_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %argv, i64 %count
  store ptr null, ptr %null_slot, align 8
  ret ptr %argv
fail:
  ret ptr null
}
define internal ptr @sollang_process_windows_text(ptr %data, i64 %length64) {
entry:
  %length_fits = icmp ule i64 %length64, 2147483647
  br i1 %length_fits, label %measure, label %fail
measure:
  %length = trunc i64 %length64 to i32
  %chars = call i32 @MultiByteToWideChar(i32 65001, i32 8, ptr %data, i32 %length, ptr null, i32 0)
  %chars_valid = icmp sgt i32 %chars, 0
  %empty = icmp eq i32 %length, 0
  %valid = or i1 %chars_valid, %empty
  br i1 %valid, label %allocate, label %fail
allocate:
  %with_null = add i32 %chars, 1
  %with_null64 = zext i32 %with_null to i64
  %bytes = mul i64 %with_null64, 2
  %wide = call ptr @malloc(i64 %bytes)
  %allocated = icmp ne ptr %wide, null
  br i1 %allocated, label %convert, label %fail
convert:
  %written = call i32 @MultiByteToWideChar(i32 65001, i32 8, ptr %data, i32 %length, ptr %wide, i32 %chars)
  %converted = icmp eq i32 %written, %chars
  br i1 %converted, label %terminate, label %free_fail
terminate:
  %end = getelementptr i16, ptr %wide, i32 %chars
  store i16 0, ptr %end, align 2
  ret ptr %wide
free_fail:
  call void @free(ptr %wide)
  br label %fail
fail:
  ret ptr null
}
define internal ptr @sollang_process_windows_path(ptr %data, i64 %length) {
entry:
  %present = icmp ugt i64 %length, 0
  br i1 %present, label %check, label %fail
check:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %advance ]
  %done = icmp eq i64 %index, %length
  br i1 %done, label %convert, label %inspect
inspect:
  %byte_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %data, i64 %index
  %byte = load i8, ptr %byte_ptr, align 1
  %nul = icmp eq i8 %byte, 0
  br i1 %nul, label %fail, label %advance
advance:
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  br label %check
convert:
  %wide = call ptr @sollang_process_windows_text(ptr %data, i64 %length)
  ret ptr %wide
fail:
  ret ptr null
}
define internal ptr @sollang_process_join_windows_args(ptr %argv, i64 %count) {
entry:
  %index_slot = alloca i64, align 8
  %offset_slot = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %index_slot, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  br label %measure_outer
measure_outer:
  %index = load i64, ptr %index_slot, align 8
  %outer_done = icmp eq i64 %index, %count
  br i1 %outer_done, label %allocate, label %measure_inner
measure_inner:
  %character_index = phi i64 [ 0, %measure_outer ], [ %character_next, %measure_more ]
  %argument_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %argv, i64 %index
  %argument = load ptr, ptr %argument_slot, align 8
  %character_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %argument, i64 %character_index
  %character = load i16, ptr %character_ptr, align 2
  %argument_done = icmp eq i16 %character, 0
  br i1 %argument_done, label %measure_argument_done, label %measure_more
measure_more:
  %character_next = add i64 %character_index, 1
  br label %measure_inner
measure_argument_done:
  %offset = load i64, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  %needs_space = icmp ne i64 %index, 0
  %space = zext i1 %needs_space to i64
  %with_argument = add i64 %offset, %character_index
  %next_offset = add i64 %with_argument, %space
  store i64 %next_offset, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  %next_index = add i64 %index, 1
  store i64 %next_index, ptr %index_slot, align 8
  br label %measure_outer
allocate:
  %total = load i64, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  %with_null = add i64 %total, 1
  %bytes = mul i64 %with_null, 2
  %command = call ptr @malloc(i64 %bytes)
  %allocated = icmp ne ptr %command, null
  br i1 %allocated, label %copy_setup, label %fail
copy_setup:
  store i64 0, ptr %index_slot, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  br label %copy_outer
copy_outer:
  %copy_index = load i64, ptr %index_slot, align 8
  %copy_done = icmp eq i64 %copy_index, %count
  br i1 %copy_done, label %terminate, label %copy_space
copy_space:
  %copy_offset = load i64, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  %copy_needs_space = icmp ne i64 %copy_index, 0
  br i1 %copy_needs_space, label %store_space, label %copy_inner
store_space:
  %space_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %command, i64 %copy_offset
  store i16 32, ptr %space_ptr, align 2
  %after_space = add i64 %copy_offset, 1
  store i64 %after_space, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  br label %copy_inner
copy_inner:
  %copy_character_index = phi i64 [ 0, %copy_space ], [ 0, %store_space ], [ %copy_character_next, %copy_more ]
  %copy_argument_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %argv, i64 %copy_index
  %copy_argument = load ptr, ptr %copy_argument_slot, align 8
  %copy_character_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %copy_argument, i64 %copy_character_index
  %copy_character = load i16, ptr %copy_character_ptr, align 2
  %copy_argument_done = icmp eq i16 %copy_character, 0
  br i1 %copy_argument_done, label %copy_argument_finish, label %copy_more
copy_more:
  %current_offset = load i64, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  %destination = getelementptr i16, ptr %command, i64 %current_offset
  store i16 %copy_character, ptr %destination, align 2
  %destination_next = add i64 %current_offset, 1
  store i64 %destination_next, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  %copy_character_next = add i64 %copy_character_index, 1
  br label %copy_inner
copy_argument_finish:
  %copy_index_next = add i64 %copy_index, 1
  store i64 %copy_index_next, ptr %index_slot, align 8
  br label %copy_outer
terminate:
  %final_offset = load i64, ptr %offset_slot, align 8
  %null_ptr = getelementptr i16, ptr %command, i64 %final_offset
  store i16 0, ptr %null_ptr, align 2
  ret ptr %command
fail:
  ret ptr null
}
define internal i64 @sollang_windows_wide_length(ptr %text) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %more ]
  %at = getelementptr i16, ptr %text, i64 %index
  %character = load i16, ptr %at, align 2
  %done = icmp eq i16 %character, 0
  br i1 %done, label %result, label %more
more:
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  br label %loop
result:
  ret i64 %index
}

define internal i64 @sollang_windows_environment_name_length(ptr %entry) {
entry_block:
  %first = load i16, ptr %entry, align 2
  %hidden = icmp eq i16 %first, 61
  %start = select i1 %hidden, i64 1, i64 0
  br label %loop
loop:
  %index = phi i64 [ %start, %entry_block ], [ %next, %more ]
  %at = getelementptr i16, ptr %entry, i64 %index
  %character = load i16, ptr %at, align 2
  %separator = icmp eq i16 %character, 61
  %end = icmp eq i16 %character, 0
  %done = or i1 %separator, %end
  br i1 %done, label %result, label %more
more:
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  br label %loop
result:
  ret i64 %index
}

define internal i1 @sollang_windows_environment_text_valid(ptr %data, i64 %length, i1 %name) {
entry:
  br label %loop
loop:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %more ]
  %done = icmp eq i64 %index, %length
  br i1 %done, label %valid, label %inspect
inspect:
  %at = getelementptr i8, ptr %data, i64 %index
  %byte = load i8, ptr %at, align 1
  %nul = icmp eq i8 %byte, 0
  %equal = icmp eq i8 %byte, 61
  %name_equal = and i1 %name, %equal
  %invalid = or i1 %nul, %name_equal
  br i1 %invalid, label %failure, label %more
more:
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  br label %loop
valid:
  ret i1 true
failure:
  ret i1 false
}

define internal i64 @sollang_windows_latest_environment_change(ptr %entries, ptr %name_lengths, i64 %count, ptr %name, i64 %name_length) {
entry:
  %name_fits = icmp ule i64 %name_length, 2147483647
  br i1 %name_fits, label %loop, label %missing
loop:
  %remaining = phi i64 [ %count, %entry ], [ %index, %different ]
  %done = icmp eq i64 %remaining, 0
  br i1 %done, label %missing, label %inspect
inspect:
  %index = sub i64 %remaining, 1
  %entry_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %entries, i64 %index
  %candidate = load ptr, ptr %entry_slot, align 8
  %length_slot = getelementptr i64, ptr %name_lengths, i64 %index
  %candidate_length64 = load i64, ptr %length_slot, align 8
  %candidate_fits = icmp ule i64 %candidate_length64, 2147483647
  br i1 %candidate_fits, label %compare, label %different
compare:
  %candidate_length = trunc i64 %candidate_length64 to i32
  %target_length = trunc i64 %name_length to i32
  %order = call i32 @CompareStringOrdinal(ptr %candidate, i32 %candidate_length, ptr %name, i32 %target_length, i32 1)
  %matches = icmp eq i32 %order, 2
  br i1 %matches, label %found, label %different
different:
  br label %loop
found:
  ret i64 %index
missing:
  ret i64 -1
}

define internal void @sollang_windows_dispose_environment_build(ptr %entries, ptr %name_lengths, ptr %list, i64 %count, ptr %parent) {
entry:
  %has_entries = icmp ne ptr %entries, null
  br i1 %has_entries, label %entry_loop, label %free_arrays
entry_loop:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %entry_more ]
  %entries_done = icmp eq i64 %index, %count
  br i1 %entries_done, label %free_arrays, label %entry_more
entry_more:
  %slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %entries, i64 %index
  %value = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 8
  call void @free(ptr %value)
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  br label %entry_loop
free_arrays:
  call void @free(ptr %entries)
  call void @free(ptr %name_lengths)
  call void @free(ptr %list)
  %has_parent = icmp ne ptr %parent, null
  br i1 %has_parent, label %free_parent, label %cleanup_done
free_parent:
  %parent_freed = call i32 @FreeEnvironmentStringsW(ptr %parent)
  br label %cleanup_done
cleanup_done:
  ret void
}

define internal %sollang.process_environment_result @sollang_windows_build_environment(ptr %changes, i64 %change_count, i1 %inherits) {
entry:
  %has_changes = icmp ne i64 %change_count, 0
  %cleared = xor i1 %inherits, true
  %custom = or i1 %has_changes, %cleared
  br i1 %custom, label %allocate_entries, label %fast
fast:
  %fast0 = insertvalue %sollang.process_environment_result poison, ptr null, 0
  %fast1 = insertvalue %sollang.process_environment_result %fast0, i64 0, 1
  %fast2 = insertvalue %sollang.process_environment_result %fast1, i64 -1, 2
  %fast3 = insertvalue %sollang.process_environment_result %fast2, i1 true, 3
  ret %sollang.process_environment_result %fast3
allocate_entries:
  %entry_slots0 = select i1 %has_changes, i64 %change_count, i64 1
  %entry_bytes = mul i64 %entry_slots0, 8
  %entries = call ptr @malloc(i64 %entry_bytes)
  %entries_ok = icmp ne ptr %entries, null
  br i1 %entries_ok, label %allocate_lengths, label %failure
allocate_lengths:
  %name_lengths = call ptr @malloc(i64 %entry_bytes)
  %lengths_ok = icmp ne ptr %name_lengths, null
  br i1 %lengths_ok, label %initialize_entries, label %free_entries_failure
initialize_entries:
  %init_index = phi i64 [ 0, %allocate_lengths ], [ %init_next, %init_more ]
  %init_done = icmp eq i64 %init_index, %change_count
  br i1 %init_done, label %convert_changes, label %init_more
init_more:
  %init_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %entries, i64 %init_index
  store ptr null, ptr %init_slot, align 8
  %init_next = add i64 %init_index, 1
  br label %initialize_entries
convert_changes:
  %change_index = phi i64 [ 0, %initialize_entries ], [ %change_next_removed, %store_removed ], [ %change_next_set, %store_set ]
  %changes_done = icmp eq i64 %change_index, %change_count
  br i1 %changes_done, label %parent_select, label %load_change
load_change:
  %change = getelementptr { %sollang.text, %sollang.text, i1 }, ptr %changes, i64 %change_index
  %name_slot = getelementptr inbounds { %sollang.text, %sollang.text, i1 }, ptr %change, i32 0, i32 0
  %name = load %sollang.text, ptr %name_slot, align 8
  %name_data = extractvalue %sollang.text %name, 0
  %name_length = extractvalue %sollang.text %name, 1
  %name_nonempty = icmp ne i64 %name_length, 0
  %name_valid0 = call i1 @sollang_windows_environment_text_valid(ptr %name_data, i64 %name_length, i1 true)
  %name_valid = and i1 %name_nonempty, %name_valid0
  %value_slot = getelementptr inbounds { %sollang.text, %sollang.text, i1 }, ptr %change, i32 0, i32 1
  %value = load %sollang.text, ptr %value_slot, align 8
  %value_data = extractvalue %sollang.text %value, 0
  %value_length = extractvalue %sollang.text %value, 1
  %value_valid = call i1 @sollang_windows_environment_text_valid(ptr %value_data, i64 %value_length, i1 false)
  %text_valid = and i1 %name_valid, %value_valid
  br i1 %text_valid, label %convert_name, label %build_failure
convert_name:
  %wide_name = call ptr @sollang_process_windows_text(ptr %name_data, i64 %name_length)
  %wide_name_ok = icmp ne ptr %wide_name, null
  br i1 %wide_name_ok, label %measure_name, label %build_failure
measure_name:
  %wide_name_length = call i64 @sollang_windows_wide_length(ptr %wide_name)
  %name_length_store = getelementptr i64, ptr %name_lengths, i64 %change_index
  store i64 %wide_name_length, ptr %name_length_store, align 8
  %removed_slot = getelementptr inbounds { %sollang.text, %sollang.text, i1 }, ptr %change, i32 0, i32 2
  %removed = load i1, ptr %removed_slot, align 1
  br i1 %removed, label %store_removed, label %convert_value
store_removed:
  %removed_entry_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %entries, i64 %change_index
  store ptr %wide_name, ptr %removed_entry_slot, align 8
  %change_next_removed = add i64 %change_index, 1
  br label %convert_changes
convert_value:
  %wide_value = call ptr @sollang_process_windows_text(ptr %value_data, i64 %value_length)
  %wide_value_ok = icmp ne ptr %wide_value, null
  br i1 %wide_value_ok, label %allocate_entry, label %free_name_failure
allocate_entry:
  %wide_value_length = call i64 @sollang_windows_wide_length(ptr %wide_value)
  %entry_without_end = add i64 %wide_name_length, %wide_value_length
  %entry_chars = add i64 %entry_without_end, 2
  %wide_entry_bytes = mul i64 %entry_chars, 2
  %wide_entry = call ptr @malloc(i64 %wide_entry_bytes)
  %wide_entry_ok = icmp ne ptr %wide_entry, null
  br i1 %wide_entry_ok, label %copy_entry, label %free_name_value_failure
copy_entry:
  %wide_name_bytes = mul i64 %wide_name_length, 2
  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %wide_entry, ptr %wide_name, i64 %wide_name_bytes, i1 false)
  %separator = getelementptr i16, ptr %wide_entry, i64 %wide_name_length
  store i16 61, ptr %separator, align 2
  %value_offset = add i64 %wide_name_length, 1
  %value_destination = getelementptr i16, ptr %wide_entry, i64 %value_offset
  %wide_value_bytes = mul i64 %wide_value_length, 2
  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %value_destination, ptr %wide_value, i64 %wide_value_bytes, i1 false)
  %entry_end_offset = add i64 %value_offset, %wide_value_length
  %entry_end = getelementptr i16, ptr %wide_entry, i64 %entry_end_offset
  store i16 0, ptr %entry_end, align 2
  call void @free(ptr %wide_name)
  call void @free(ptr %wide_value)
  br label %store_set
store_set:
  %set_entry_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %entries, i64 %change_index
  store ptr %wide_entry, ptr %set_entry_slot, align 8
  %change_next_set = add i64 %change_index, 1
  br label %convert_changes
free_name_failure:
  call void @free(ptr %wide_name)
  br label %build_failure
free_name_value_failure:
  call void @free(ptr %wide_name)
  call void @free(ptr %wide_value)
  br label %build_failure
parent_select:
  br i1 %inherits, label %load_parent, label %allocate_list
load_parent:
  %parent = call ptr @GetEnvironmentStringsW()
  %parent_ok = icmp ne ptr %parent, null
  br i1 %parent_ok, label %count_parent, label %build_failure
count_parent:
  %parent_count = phi i64 [ 0, %load_parent ], [ %parent_count_next, %parent_more ]
  %parent_cursor = phi ptr [ %parent, %load_parent ], [ %parent_next, %parent_more ]
  %parent_first = load i16, ptr %parent_cursor, align 2
  %parent_done = icmp eq i16 %parent_first, 0
  br i1 %parent_done, label %allocate_list, label %parent_more
parent_more:
  %parent_length = call i64 @sollang_windows_wide_length(ptr %parent_cursor)
  %parent_stride = add i64 %parent_length, 1
  %parent_next = getelementptr i16, ptr %parent_cursor, i64 %parent_stride
  %parent_count_next = add i64 %parent_count, 1
  br label %count_parent
allocate_list:
  %selected_parent = phi ptr [ null, %parent_select ], [ %parent, %count_parent ]
  %selected_parent_count = phi i64 [ 0, %parent_select ], [ %parent_count, %count_parent ]
  %maximum_count = add i64 %selected_parent_count, %change_count
  %list_slots = add i64 %maximum_count, 1
  %list_bytes = mul i64 %list_slots, 8
  %list = call ptr @malloc(i64 %list_bytes)
  %list_ok = icmp ne ptr %list, null
  br i1 %list_ok, label %copy_parent, label %build_failure_with_parent
copy_parent:
  %copy_parent_index = phi i64 [ 0, %allocate_list ], [ %copy_parent_next, %copy_parent_continue ]
  %copy_parent_cursor = phi ptr [ %selected_parent, %allocate_list ], [ %copy_parent_cursor_next, %copy_parent_continue ]
  %kept_count = phi i64 [ 0, %allocate_list ], [ %kept_next, %copy_parent_continue ]
  %copy_parent_done = icmp eq i64 %copy_parent_index, %selected_parent_count
  br i1 %copy_parent_done, label %append_changes, label %copy_parent_inspect
copy_parent_inspect:
  %parent_entry_length = call i64 @sollang_windows_wide_length(ptr %copy_parent_cursor)
  %parent_name_length = call i64 @sollang_windows_environment_name_length(ptr %copy_parent_cursor)
  %parent_change = call i64 @sollang_windows_latest_environment_change(ptr %entries, ptr %name_lengths, i64 %change_count, ptr %copy_parent_cursor, i64 %parent_name_length)
  %parent_overridden = icmp sge i64 %parent_change, 0
  br i1 %parent_overridden, label %copy_parent_skip, label %copy_parent_keep
copy_parent_keep:
  %parent_destination = getelementptr ptr, ptr %list, i64 %kept_count
  store ptr %copy_parent_cursor, ptr %parent_destination, align 8
  %kept_after_copy = add i64 %kept_count, 1
  br label %copy_parent_continue
copy_parent_skip:
  br label %copy_parent_continue
copy_parent_continue:
  %kept_next = phi i64 [ %kept_after_copy, %copy_parent_keep ], [ %kept_count, %copy_parent_skip ]
  %copy_parent_stride = add i64 %parent_entry_length, 1
  %copy_parent_cursor_next = getelementptr i16, ptr %copy_parent_cursor, i64 %copy_parent_stride
  %copy_parent_next = add i64 %copy_parent_index, 1
  br label %copy_parent
append_changes:
  %append_index = phi i64 [ 0, %copy_parent ], [ %append_next, %append_continue ]
  %output_count = phi i64 [ %kept_count, %copy_parent ], [ %output_next, %append_continue ]
  %append_done = icmp eq i64 %append_index, %change_count
  br i1 %append_done, label %sort_outer, label %append_inspect
append_inspect:
  %append_entry_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %entries, i64 %append_index
  %append_entry = load ptr, ptr %append_entry_slot, align 8
  %append_name_length_slot = getelementptr i64, ptr %name_lengths, i64 %append_index
  %append_name_length = load i64, ptr %append_name_length_slot, align 8
  %latest = call i64 @sollang_windows_latest_environment_change(ptr %entries, ptr %name_lengths, i64 %change_count, ptr %append_entry, i64 %append_name_length)
  %is_latest = icmp eq i64 %latest, %append_index
  br i1 %is_latest, label %append_latest, label %append_skip
append_latest:
  %append_change = getelementptr { %sollang.text, %sollang.text, i1 }, ptr %changes, i64 %append_index
  %append_removed_slot = getelementptr inbounds { %sollang.text, %sollang.text, i1 }, ptr %append_change, i32 0, i32 2
  %append_removed = load i1, ptr %append_removed_slot, align 1
  br i1 %append_removed, label %append_skip, label %append_keep
append_keep:
  %append_destination = getelementptr ptr, ptr %list, i64 %output_count
  store ptr %append_entry, ptr %append_destination, align 8
  %output_after_append = add i64 %output_count, 1
  br label %append_continue
append_skip:
  br label %append_continue
append_continue:
  %output_next = phi i64 [ %output_after_append, %append_keep ], [ %output_count, %append_skip ]
  %append_next = add i64 %append_index, 1
  br label %append_changes
sort_outer:
  %sort_index = phi i64 [ 1, %append_changes ], [ %sort_next, %sort_store ]
  %sort_done = icmp uge i64 %sort_index, %output_count
  br i1 %sort_done, label %measure_block, label %sort_load
sort_load:
  %sort_key_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %list, i64 %sort_index
  %sort_key = load ptr, ptr %sort_key_slot, align 8
  br label %sort_inner
sort_inner:
  %sort_position = phi i64 [ %sort_index, %sort_load ], [ %sort_previous, %sort_shift ]
  %at_start = icmp eq i64 %sort_position, 0
  br i1 %at_start, label %sort_store, label %sort_compare
sort_compare:
  %sort_previous = sub i64 %sort_position, 1
  %sort_previous_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %list, i64 %sort_previous
  %sort_previous_value = load ptr, ptr %sort_previous_slot, align 8
  %sort_order = call i32 @CompareStringOrdinal(ptr %sort_key, i32 -1, ptr %sort_previous_value, i32 -1, i32 1)
  %sort_before = icmp eq i32 %sort_order, 1
  br i1 %sort_before, label %sort_shift, label %sort_store
sort_shift:
  %sort_shift_destination = getelementptr ptr, ptr %list, i64 %sort_position
  store ptr %sort_previous_value, ptr %sort_shift_destination, align 8
  br label %sort_inner
sort_store:
  %sort_destination = getelementptr ptr, ptr %list, i64 %sort_position
  store ptr %sort_key, ptr %sort_destination, align 8
  %sort_next = add i64 %sort_index, 1
  br label %sort_outer
measure_block:
  %measure_index = phi i64 [ 0, %sort_outer ], [ %measure_next, %measure_more ]
  %measure_chars = phi i64 [ 0, %sort_outer ], [ %measure_total, %measure_more ]
  %measure_done = icmp eq i64 %measure_index, %output_count
  br i1 %measure_done, label %allocate_block, label %measure_more
measure_more:
  %measure_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %list, i64 %measure_index
  %measure_entry = load ptr, ptr %measure_slot, align 8
  %measure_length = call i64 @sollang_windows_wide_length(ptr %measure_entry)
  %measure_with_null = add i64 %measure_length, 1
  %measure_total = add i64 %measure_chars, %measure_with_null
  %measure_next = add i64 %measure_index, 1
  br label %measure_block
allocate_block:
  %empty_block = icmp eq i64 %output_count, 0
  %nonempty_chars = add i64 %measure_chars, 1
  %block_chars = select i1 %empty_block, i64 2, i64 %nonempty_chars
  %block_bytes = mul i64 %block_chars, 2
  %block = call ptr @malloc(i64 %block_bytes)
  %block_ok = icmp ne ptr %block, null
  br i1 %block_ok, label %copy_block, label %build_failure_with_list
copy_block:
  %block_index = phi i64 [ 0, %allocate_block ], [ %block_next, %block_more ]
  %block_offset = phi i64 [ 0, %allocate_block ], [ %block_offset_next, %block_more ]
  %block_done = icmp eq i64 %block_index, %output_count
  br i1 %block_done, label %terminate_block, label %block_more
block_more:
  %block_entry_slot = getelementptr ptr, ptr %list, i64 %block_index
  %block_entry = load ptr, ptr %block_entry_slot, align 8
  %block_entry_length = call i64 @sollang_windows_wide_length(ptr %block_entry)
  %block_copy_chars = add i64 %block_entry_length, 1
  %block_copy_bytes = mul i64 %block_copy_chars, 2
  %block_destination = getelementptr i16, ptr %block, i64 %block_offset
  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %block_destination, ptr %block_entry, i64 %block_copy_bytes, i1 false)
  %block_offset_next = add i64 %block_offset, %block_copy_chars
  %block_next = add i64 %block_index, 1
  br label %copy_block
terminate_block:
  %final_null = getelementptr i16, ptr %block, i64 %block_offset
  store i16 0, ptr %final_null, align 2
  %empty_second = getelementptr i16, ptr %block, i64 1
  br i1 %empty_block, label %terminate_empty, label %finish
terminate_empty:
  store i16 0, ptr %empty_second, align 2
  br label %finish
finish:
  call void @sollang_windows_dispose_environment_build(ptr %entries, ptr %name_lengths, ptr %list, i64 %change_count, ptr %selected_parent)
  %ok0 = insertvalue %sollang.process_environment_result poison, ptr %block, 0
  %ok1 = insertvalue %sollang.process_environment_result %ok0, i64 0, 1
  %ok2 = insertvalue %sollang.process_environment_result %ok1, i64 -1, 2
  %ok3 = insertvalue %sollang.process_environment_result %ok2, i1 true, 3
  ret %sollang.process_environment_result %ok3
build_failure_with_list:
  call void @sollang_windows_dispose_environment_build(ptr %entries, ptr %name_lengths, ptr %list, i64 %change_count, ptr %selected_parent)
  br label %failure
build_failure_with_parent:
  call void @sollang_windows_dispose_environment_build(ptr %entries, ptr %name_lengths, ptr null, i64 %change_count, ptr %selected_parent)
  br label %failure
build_failure:
  call void @sollang_windows_dispose_environment_build(ptr %entries, ptr %name_lengths, ptr null, i64 %change_count, ptr null)
  br label %failure
free_entries_failure:
  call void @free(ptr %entries)
  br label %failure
failure:
  ret %sollang.process_environment_result zeroinitializer
}


define internal ptr @sollang_process_inherit_windows_handle(ptr %source) {
entry:
  %process = call ptr @GetCurrentProcess()
  %target_slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  %duplicated = call i32 @DuplicateHandle(ptr %process, ptr %source, ptr %process, ptr %target_slot, i32 0, i32 1, i32 2)
  %ok = icmp ne i32 %duplicated, 0
  br i1 %ok, label %success, label %fail
success:
  %target = load ptr, ptr %target_slot, align 8
  ret ptr %target
fail:
  ret ptr null
}
define internal i64 @sollang_process_spawn_windows(ptr %program, ptr %argv, i64 %count, ptr %working_directory, ptr %environment, ptr %stdin_override, ptr %stdout_override, ptr %stderr_override) {
entry:
  %command = call ptr @sollang_process_join_windows_args(ptr %argv, i64 %count)
  %command_ok = icmp ne ptr %command, null
  br i1 %command_ok, label %handles, label %fail
handles:
  %stdin_default_value = call i64 @_get_osfhandle(i32 0)
  %stdin_default = inttoptr i64 %stdin_default_value to ptr
  %has_stdin_override = icmp ne ptr %stdin_override, null
  %stdin_source = select i1 %has_stdin_override, ptr %stdin_override, ptr %stdin_default
  %stdout_default_value = call i64 @_get_osfhandle(i32 1)
  %stdout_default = inttoptr i64 %stdout_default_value to ptr
  %has_stdout_override = icmp ne ptr %stdout_override, null
  %stdout_source = select i1 %has_stdout_override, ptr %stdout_override, ptr %stdout_default
  %stderr_default_value = call i64 @_get_osfhandle(i32 2)
  %stderr_default = inttoptr i64 %stderr_default_value to ptr
  %has_stderr_override = icmp ne ptr %stderr_override, null
  %stderr_source = select i1 %has_stderr_override, ptr %stderr_override, ptr %stderr_default
  %stdin_handle = call ptr @sollang_process_inherit_windows_handle(ptr %stdin_source)
  %stdout_handle = call ptr @sollang_process_inherit_windows_handle(ptr %stdout_source)
  %stderr_handle = call ptr @sollang_process_inherit_windows_handle(ptr %stderr_source)
  %stdin_ok = icmp ne ptr %stdin_handle, null
  %stdout_ok = icmp ne ptr %stdout_handle, null
  %stderr_ok = icmp ne ptr %stderr_handle, null
  %io_ok0 = and i1 %stdin_ok, %stdout_ok
  %io_ok = and i1 %io_ok0, %stderr_ok
  br i1 %io_ok, label %create, label %close_handles_fail
create:
  %startup = alloca [104 x i8], align 8
  %process_info = alloca [24 x i8], align 8
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %startup, i8 0, i64 104, i1 false)
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %process_info, i8 0, i64 24, i1 false)
  store i32 104, ptr %startup, align 4
  %flags_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %startup, i64 60
  store i32 256, ptr %flags_ptr, align 4
  %stdin_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %startup, i64 80
  store ptr %stdin_handle, ptr %stdin_ptr, align 8
  %stdout_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %startup, i64 88
  store ptr %stdout_handle, ptr %stdout_ptr, align 8
  %stderr_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %startup, i64 96
  store ptr %stderr_handle, ptr %stderr_ptr, align 8
  %has_environment = icmp ne ptr %environment, null
  %creation_flags = select i1 %has_environment, i32 1024, i32 0
  %created = call i32 @CreateProcessW(ptr %program, ptr %command, ptr null, ptr null, i32 1, i32 %creation_flags, ptr %environment, ptr %working_directory, ptr %startup, ptr %process_info)
  %created_ok = icmp ne i32 %created, 0
  br i1 %created_ok, label %spawned, label %close_handles_fail
spawned:
  %process_handle = load ptr, ptr %process_info, align 8
  %thread_ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %process_info, i64 8
  %thread_handle = load ptr, ptr %thread_ptr, align 8
  %closed_thread = call i32 @CloseHandle(ptr %thread_handle)
  %closed_stdin = call i32 @CloseHandle(ptr %stdin_handle)
  %closed_stdout = call i32 @CloseHandle(ptr %stdout_handle)
  %closed_stderr = call i32 @CloseHandle(ptr %stderr_handle)
  call void @free(ptr %command)
  %token = ptrtoint ptr %process_handle to i64
  ret i64 %token
close_handles_fail:
  br i1 %stdin_ok, label %close_stdin, label %close_stdout
close_stdin:
  %closed_stdin_fail = call i32 @CloseHandle(ptr %stdin_handle)
  br label %close_stdout
close_stdout:
  br i1 %stdout_ok, label %close_stdout_present, label %close_stderr
close_stdout_present:
  %closed_stdout_fail = call i32 @CloseHandle(ptr %stdout_handle)
  br label %close_stderr
close_stderr:
  br i1 %stderr_ok, label %close_stderr_present, label %free_fail
close_stderr_present:
  %closed_stderr_fail = call i32 @CloseHandle(ptr %stderr_handle)
  br label %free_fail
free_fail:
  call void @free(ptr %command)
  br label %fail
fail:
  ret i64 -1
}
define internal %sollang.process_spawn_result @sollang_spawn_process_with_stdio(ptr %records, i64 %count, ptr %working_directory_data, i64 %working_directory_length, i1 %has_working_directory, ptr %environment_changes, i64 %environment_change_count, i1 %inherits_environment, ptr %stdin_override, ptr %stdout_override, ptr %stderr_override) {
entry:
  %has_program = icmp ugt i64 %count, 0
  br i1 %has_program, label %build, label %error
build:
  %program_slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  %argv = call ptr @sollang_process_build_windows_argv(ptr %records, i64 %count, ptr %program_slot)
  %built = icmp ne ptr %argv, null
  br i1 %built, label %spawn, label %error
spawn:
  %program = load ptr, ptr %program_slot, align 8
  br i1 %has_working_directory, label %working_directory_convert, label %spawn_ready
